abstract: This work describes the designing and development of an AI-driven SQL learning and teaching platform that could be used for automating SQL query generation, evaluation, and feedback. Based on NLP and AI methodologies, the proposed platform makes use of Ollama’s Llama 3 for schema extraction, question generation, and grading. For answer generation, a fine-tuned Llama 3 model on a variation of the spider dataset is used. MongoDB has been utilized for scalable data storage and React for an intuitive front-end interface. The platform enables an instructor to upload datasets and automatically generate SQL-based tests for students. Students are also given immediate feedback regarding their SQL queries, which otherwise is a labor-intensive task. The platform can also overcome challenges that traditional SQL education face, such as inconsistency in grading and delay in giving feedback, thereby offering personalized feedback, comprehensive performance reports, and engaging learners. Our solution would lighten the burden of teaching SQL by ensuring less effort from instructors while teaching their students dynamically, through the assessment of queries in a real-time setting. By automation in conjunction with the feature of real-time interactivity, this solution has been steered toward an effective and scalable learning experience for SQL by both educators and learners.

articleTitle: An extensive critique on advances in digital control techniques for smart grid and micro grid operation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The integration of digital control techniques within smart grids and microgrids represents a pivotal advancement in the optimization, reliability, and efficiency of modern electrical networks. This paper explores the latest developments in digital control strategies, focusing on their application to the operation of smart grids and microgrids. Key areas of discussion include the implementation of advanced algorithms for real-time monitoring and control, the role of artificial intelligence and machine learning in predictive maintenance and decision-making, and the impact of distributed control systems on grid stability and resilience. Furthermore, the paper examines the challenges and solutions associated with integrating renewable energy sources and energy storage systems into the grid, emphasizing the importance of adaptive and scalable control frameworks. Through a comprehensive review of recent research and case studies, this paper provides insights into the future trends and potential breakthroughs in digital control technologies, highlighting their critical role in the evolution of smart grid and microgrid infrastructures. The findings suggest that continued innovation in this field will significantly enhance the operational capabilities of electrical grids, paving the way for more sustainable and resilient energy systems.

articleTitle: Thyroid Disease Prediction Using Selective Features and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study explores an advanced approach to thyroid disease prediction using selective features and machine learning techniques. The proposed methodology uses Bayesian Search for hyperparameter tuning in combination with ensemble learning methods such as Random Forest, XGBoost, and Gradient Boosting to improve model performance. Traditional hyperparameter tuning methods such as grid search and random search are often computationally intensive and time-consuming. In contrast, Bayesian Search efficiently explores the hyperparameter space and reduces the number of iterations needed to find the optimal setting. Ensemble learning techniques, known for their ability to combine multiple algorithms to achieve higher accuracy and robustness, are used to further improve predictive performance. By combining Bayesian Search and ensemble learning, the study aims to create a reliable predictive model for thyroid disorder detection with a focus on improving accuracy and minimizing computational overhead. The results show that this integrated approach offers a powerful framework for enhancing the model's performance in predictive tasks, paving the way for its application in other medical diagnoses and beyond.

articleTitle: A Novel Voice-Activated Cleaning System for Smart Homes
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents the design and testing of a voice-activated cleaning system for home automation. The system allows users to control a floor cleaning robot using voice commands. The robot is equipped with a Bluetooth module and a microcontroller that processes the voice commands received from a mobile device. The user can give various voice commands such as "move forward", "move back", "turn right", "turn left", "clean", "rotate", and "stop" to control the robot's movements and cleaning functions. The system utilizes speech recognition technology to convert the voice commands into digital signals that are then transmitted to the robot's microcontroller. The robot's movements are controlled by servo motors, and it also has a camera for live video transmission and recording. The software is implemented using the Arduino IDE and embedded C programming. The system aims to provide a convenient and hands-free way of controlling a cleaning robot, reducing manual effort required for floor cleaning tasks.

articleTitle: Automated Sleep Stage Classification and Music Therapy Recommendation for sleep Disorder
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This work hereby proposes a new framework in the classification of stages of sleep, followed by personalized music therapy, in treating sleep disorders related to insomnia, sleep apnea, and narcolepsy. The proposed system is empowered with state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms applied to PSG data to enhance the detection of a variety of stages of sleep using real-time physiological signals such as EEG, EOG, and EMG. This system, Dream Tunes, provides personalized music therapy adapted to the detected sleep stages and thus improves quality sleep and, in general, therapeutic outcomes. The use of machine learning for treatment with music is an effective non-invasive intervention that can enhance sleep health. Testing confirms the viability of the approach proposed by higher accuracy in sleep stage detection and personalized music recommendation. Thus, the given study represented a huge development in the field of somnology with the use of technology and therapeutic ways to support better management of sleep.

articleTitle: Grid-To-Vehicle (G2V) and Vehicle-To-Grid (V2G) in Hybrid AC/DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The integration of electric vehicles (EVs) into hybrid AC/DC microgrids presents transformative potential for energy management, enabling Grid-To-Vehicle (G2V) and Vehicle-To-Grid (V2G) operations. This paper explores the bidirectional interaction between the power grid and EVs in hybrid microgrid systems, focusing on the operational, technical, and economic impacts of G2V and V2G within these networks. G2V allows EVs to be charged efficiently from the grid, while V2G enables EVs to act as distributed energy storage units, providing ancillary services and stabilizing grid load fluctuations. The dual role of EVs as both load and distributed energy resource (DER) offers unique advantages for power balancing, renewable energy integration, and peak shaving in hybrid microgrids that incorporate both AC and DC infrastructures. Key challenges addressed include compatibility of EVs with hybrid AC/DC interfaces, control strategies for seamless transitions between G2V and V2G modes, and optimization of energy flow to ensure grid stability and maximize cost-efficiency. Advanced control algorithms are proposed to manage the dynamic load demands and bidirectional energy flows in real-time, leveraging hierarchical control structures that enhance system reliability and resilience. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategies in improving overall grid performance, reducing dependency on conventional power sources, and promoting sustainable energy practices. The findings underline the potential of G2V and V2G systems as integral components of future microgrids, supporting the broader goals of sustainable transportation and resilient power infrastructures.

articleTitle: Management Practices for Sustainable Agriculture in the Age of Smart Farming
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: One of the objectives of this work is the development of the Fusion Enhanced Smart Farming System (FESFS), which includes elements of the Internet of Things, Precision Agriculture, Machine Learning, and big data technologies for the benefit of agriculture. The pivotal techniques are Temporal Fusion Transformers (TFT) for time series analysis, Graph Neural Networks (GNN) for spatial data analysis and Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) for data enhancement. The implementation of intelligent sensors, drone imaging, automatic irrigation, and real-time monitoring increases the accuracy of the data collected and the management of the resources utilized. This model showed improved crop yield by 42%, decreased water usage by 30%, improved soil health by 25% and increased operational efficiency by 31%, making it superior productive technology for the FESFS.

articleTitle: Document Storage and Retrieval with Efficient Clustering Using the Vector Space Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The exponential growth of unstructured digital data transcends traditional document-retrieval systems wherein advanced strategies are built that will help realize improved efficiency and scalability. Here is a retrieval system that combines clustering techniques with the Vector Space Model and cosine similarity. The work retrieved in this study integrates k-means and hierarchical clustering, thus reducing search space, allowing enhanced retrieval speed and scalability. The clustering-augmented VSM has better recall and F1-scores especially for semantically complex queries compared to the BM25 model. The use of LSM trees improves indexing and can be used to manage high-dimensional data efficiently. Empirical tests confirm the effectiveness of the system, making it ideal for healthcare, finance, and legal research, where real-time and precise data retrieval is important.

articleTitle: Transportation for Elders for Medical Appointments and Wheelchair Booking and Installation Mobile App
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The increasing aging population necessitates innovative solutions to address transportation challenges faced by elders, particularly for medical appointments. This paper presents a mobile application designed to streamline the process of booking transportation and wheelchair accessibility for elderly individuals. The app integrates a user-friendly interface with real-time scheduling, ensuring that users can easily arrange rides tailored to their medical needs. Key features include the ability to request wheelchair-accessible vehicles, track drivers, and receive reminders for upcoming appointments. By utilizing location-based services and advanced algorithms, the application optimizes routing and reduces wait times, enhancing overall user experience. Furthermore, the app fosters community engagement by connecting users with local volunteer drivers. The proposed solution aims to improve healthcare access for elders, promoting independence and well-being while addressing the critical barriers to transportation faced by this demographic. Future work will focus on user feedback and iterative design to ensure the app meets the specific needs of its users.

articleTitle: Enhancing Mental Wellbeing Among College Students Using Autogen
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Mental health support is crucial for students, who are vulnerable to challenges due to academic pressures and social expectations. University culture often fosters misconceptions about mental well-being, leading to stigma that discourages students from seeking help. This project introduces an AI Therapist—a conversational agent offering a private, non-judgmental space for students to discuss personal challenges. Using Sentiment Analysis, a Natural Language Processing (NLP) method powered by machine learning, the system evaluates the emotional tone of these interactions. Through this analysis, the AI provides insights into students' mental health over time, visualized through data reports generated with tools like matplotlib. These reports allow students to track their emotional journey and promote self-awareness. The goal is to create an accessible support system that encourages self-reflection, reduces the stigma around mental health, and fosters early intervention.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Anomaly detection in Distributed energy resources for Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The rapid emergence and evolution of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) has greatly impacted the energy distribution industry. This has led to the transformation of the traditional distribution system into a smart grid. Although the design strategies for smart grids have been studied by academic researchers, there is currently no practical guidance available for the industry on how to improve the level of intelligence in the grid. An industrial control system (ICS) is a type of device that monitors and controls the activities of an industrial environment. Unlike other forms of communication, the traffic of ICS is stable, regular, and periodical. Through statistical modeling, we can analyze the various features of this communication to create a statistical profile of its performance. For instance, by observing the inter-arrival and packet direction of this communication, we can identify the distribution of features that are useful in analyzing the communication. Due to the complexity of the issue, many researchers are currently working on developing techniques to detect anomalous intrusions in smart grids. Unfortunately, there is not enough experience in this field to develop effective approaches. Another issue that emerges when implementing pattern recognition techniques is that it can be very challenging to identify the signals. Due to the nature of the data in smart grids, there are often high levels of misclassification. The ability to detect and prevent power outages is very important for the safety and operation of the power grid. Modern technologies have evolved to provide a large and complex cyber physical system (CPS) that can monitor and control the various components of the power grid. The power grid is continuously improving due to the advancements in technology, and the number of sensors and measurement devices that can be used to monitor and control the system will increase. Unfortunately, this increase in data can overwhelm the existing Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system. Here we proposed artificial intelligence (AI) based anomaly detection in CPS.

articleTitle: Occlusion Resilient Face Recognition and Alert System based on Siamese Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Face recognition is widely used in various applications. While current techniques perform well in controlled settings, accurately recognizing occluded faces remains challenging. This is crucial in computer vision for surveillance and public safety, where partial occlusions often compromise identification accuracy. This work aims to develop a model for detecting occluded faces and improving recognition accuracy in partial occlusion scenarios. We also plan to integrate this model with a real-time monitoring module accessible via a web-based GUI. Experiments conducted using the publicly available Labeled Faces dataset, along with a custom dataset, demonstrated 84.49% accuracy for Siamese Model. The system was tested in real-time, providing administrators with email alerts for unknown individuals through an intuitive interface.

articleTitle: Signup page using Face recognition authentication
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Improvements in artificial intelligence and machine learning have led to the growing integration of face recognition technology for a wide range of applications, from security systems to social media. Three related uses of facial processing technology are examined in this abstract: face detection, face recognition, and authentication through a face-based signup page. Finding and differentiating human faces in an image frame requires the first step, face detection. It also recognizes the facial features and separates them from other items in the frame using computer vision algorithms. Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG), and the Haar Cascade, are the methods used for face recognition. Still, due to failure in extracting facial features in harsh conditions, we use the more recent deep learning models like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to do this project. Building on detection and face recognition compares the observed faces to known faces in a database to identify or to confirm a person’s identity. To assess distinctive facial traits (embeddings) or features and increase recognition accuracy across a variety of circumstances, like varying lighting and angles, modern face recognition systems employ deep learning models, such as Face Net and Deep Face. The Facial Recognition The signup page serves as an example of how face recognition can be used in authentication systems for secure apps. A user registers for this program by having their face captured, and this information is safely kept and acts as a unique identification. The solution gives a hands-free and password-less authentication mechanism during login by comparing the captured face with the stored data in the database.

articleTitle: Enhancing Accessibility: A Real-Time Mobile Application for Visual Narration and Text Recognition for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: People with visual impairments frequently struggle to comprehend their environment. This study proposes a mobile application designed to provide real-time descriptions of activities occurring around visually impaired individuals. By capturing live video through the mobile camera, the app generates a descriptive narrative of the video, which is conveyed to the user via audio output, enabling a more accessible experience of their environment. The system employs OpenCV for capturing visual data, while Tesseract OCR is used to identify and recognize text from the documents. The Google Text-to-Speech API converts this text into speech, using libraries like Pydub and Librosa for additional audio processing. The proposed system hence results in advancement of accessibility to surroundings, through automatic event localization and text-based descriptions of complex visual data.

articleTitle: Helmet and Equipment Detection with Worker’s Mobility Tracker In Mining Sector Using YOLOv8 & LSTM
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Monitoring personal protective equipment and compliance with safety procedures for mining operations is essential to ensuring personnel safety. Nevertheless, sending humans underground is impractical, as mining conditions are fast-changing and dangerous. Most of the existing systems are still not able to detect helmets, PPE, and the worker mobility in real-time, which are two critical aspects of safety. To overcome these challenges, this project bases its approach on enhancing monitoring and security by integrating machine learning technologies. Using YOLOv8, a cutting-edge object detection model, the system enables workers' helmet and PPE detection in real-time. This work also uses Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), a special type of RNN, to track the behavior of workers within and over time. By reading the frames at 10 millisecond intervals, the system detects movement deviations be it unsafe movements or fatigue induced deviations and provides proactive measures for safety. The devised method reaches an outstanding accuracy of 95.9%, combining YOLOv8 and LSTM, which reduces human error and improves safety at the workplace. This state-of-the-art solution is not only providing continuous monitoring but is also increasing operational efficiency, thereby transforming safety solutions in the mining space.

articleTitle: A Review of Various Optimization Techniques for the Selection of Insulating Fluids in Power and Distribution Transformer Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The selection of insulating fluids is critical for the reliable and efficient operation of power and distribution transformers. This paper provides a comprehensive review of various optimization techniques employed to select the most suitable insulating fluids for these applications. The focus is on evaluating the performance, environmental impact, and economic feasibility of different fluids, including mineral oils, synthetic esters, and natural esters. We analyze optimization methods such as genetic algorithms, particle swarm optimization, and multi-criteria decision-making approaches, highlighting their advantages and limitations. Additionally, this review addresses recent advancements and future directions in the field, aiming to guide researchers and engineers in making informed decisions for transformer insulation. By synthesizing existing studies, this paper contributes to the development of more efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective transformer systems.

articleTitle: SmokerBeacon: Hybrid Real-Time Smoking Detection Using Object Detection and Gas Sensor
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Enforcing smoking bans in public areas remains a challenge due to limitations in conventional monitoring methods. This paper introduces SmokerBeacon, an innovative system for real-time detection of smoking activities in restricted zones. SmokerBeacon uses gas sensors and advanced image classification - YOLO to identify smoking activities. The system catego-rizes detection scenarios into three types: (i) instances where smoking actions are detected by YOLO without corresponding signals from gas sensors, (ii) cases where YOLO fails to detect smoking actions despite gas sensors detecting smoking-related substances, and (iii) situations where both smoking activities and corroborating signals from gas sensors confirm smoking. Each scenario triggers specific actions to improve enforcement and foster healthier environments. By generating timely alerts and enabling proactive intervention, SmokerBeacon mitigates risks associated with smoking in prohibited areas, leveraging IoT technology.

articleTitle: Immersive Urban Narratives: Augmented Reality Data Visualization for Smart City Engagement
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper explores the transformative role of Augmented Reality (AR) in shaping smart city systems by combining four models of AR for: Real-Time navigation system for pedestrian safety, Smart retail and commerce, construction visualization and lastly for enhancing tourism. These models utilize advanced frameworks like Unity’s AR Foundation, ARCore in combination with Python in order to process the data in real time to enhance the decision-making ability of the model.The pedestrian navigation system focuses on pedestrian mobility and safety, guiding them through hazardous areas and optimizing traffic light interactions using real-time simulations. In smart retail, AR data visualization enhances customer experience and involvement by providing real-time product information, improving the transparency of the supply chain and preventing product damage through interactive AR markers. Meanwhile, the construction visualization model aids architects in capturing the site-specific measurements by generating boundary sketches and selecting building templates to enhance their design accuracy and reducing their resource waste. Lastly, the AR-enhanced tourism model provides an immersive city experience by overlaying historical, environmental and logistical data on real-world settings which improves both the tourist engagement and urban management.By combining these models, the paper demonstrates the potential of AR to revolutionize diverse sectors within smart cities, from infrastructure planning to retail, construction and tourism. This interdisciplinary approach highlights the versatility of AR in various sectors within a smart city environment in enhancing resource efficiency, safety and user experience, making it a critical tool future urban development.

articleTitle: Literature Review on Image Enhancement and Restorage in Dim Light-Captured Images
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The pursuit of high-quality digital imaging faces significant challenges in low-light conditions, marked by diminished visibility, heightened noise, and a loss of intricate details. This paper explores the transformative role of contrast enhancement methods in overcoming these challenges. Beginning with an overview of the landscape, it delves into the effectiveness of histogram equalization (HE) methods, emphasizing their role in distributing pixel intensities and enhancing overall contrast. Additionally, adaptive frequency methods are proposed to specifically address low visibility, blurred details, and noise, offering a targeted solution for enhancing image quality in challenging lighting conditions. The survey of contrast enhancement methods extends to illumination-based enhancements, generative techniques, and their significance across domains such as surveillance, photography, and medical imaging. As technological advancements and ethical considerations shape the future, the integration of deep learning techniques holds promise for further breakthroughs in improving visibility, reducing noise, and restoring crucial details in dim light-captured images.

articleTitle: Text Summarization for Light Weight Devices
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a text summarization method for low-compute devices with limited hardware capabilities like smartphones, tablets and IOT devices. Traditional methods for text summarization face significant challenges in the settings where these devices are used, given their limited computational power and memory. We present optimization algorithms that target reducing computation and memory effort whilst retaining quality in the summarization. Our solution focuses on lightweight, efficient methods to runtime–compress the summaries generated by a powerful but heavy model –in order to allow them to be computed with high mobility and little energy consumption by small devices– for example through techniques of model compression, quantization or similarity detection in datasets− thus achieving tractable abstraction of useful information from digital content [2], enhancing their accessibility experience while taking advantage of relevant mobile behaviors. Our approach enables efficient summarization with high performance and minimal resource costs, as shown by the corresponding experimental results.

articleTitle: Review on Enhancing Electric Vehicle Performance and Sustainability through Advanced Motor Technology and Thermal Management
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper examines thermal management systems that are essential for the optimal and dependable performance of electric vehicle (EV) motors, focusing on inverters, stators, and cooling plates. Inverters convert DC to AC, allowing for motor speed control and efficient power distribution. Stators generate a rotating magnetic field, producing the necessary torque, while cooling plates regulate temperatures by absorbing and releasing excess heat. These components work together to improve motor efficiency, prolong operational lifespan, and enhance energy conservation. By exploring their roles and interactions, this paper highlights innovations in EV motor technology, emphasizing their significance for the sustainability and scalability of electric transportation systems

articleTitle: NutriScan: A Mobile Application for Health-Conscious Food Choices
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In response to the need for tools that streamline the extraction of nutritional information, this study presents a sophisticated technique to automatically detect nutrition tables and identify ingredients on packaged foods. Accurate tools are crucial for portion control and making educated food choices as awareness of healthy eating grows. We increase the accuracy of identifying nutrition tables and ingredients by improving the EfficientDet model. Regular expressions collect important nutritional information including sodium, carbs, fats, proteins, additives, and allergies, while PaddleOCR further refines text extraction. Customers can indicate dietary preferences and sensitivities (such as to sugar, fat, or salt) using a customized user preference system. Our technology assesses food items based on this, providing users with a Nutri-Score that is in line with their health objectives and personalized suggestions. The correctness and effectiveness of our method are confirmed by extensive testing.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for Food Waste Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: For the purpose of reducing financial losses and environmental impacts, food waste detection is essential. Inorder to detect food waste using image processing, this study investigates the efficiency of several machine learning algorithms, including Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest, and Inception Model (IV3). A set of images of food are then processed. Before each algorithm is used for classification, pre-processing methods like segmentation and feature extraction are used.

articleTitle: Intelligent Rail Sentinel a perspective of Indian Railway
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The paper presents a PLC and SCADA-based advanced safety system design for railway signaling and interlocking. While the Indian Railway systems are infrequently beset by issues, a solitary mishap over an extended timeframe might profoundly adversely affect various facets of life and property. These issues can be resolved through the implementation of interlocking and railway signaling systems. In railways, railway personnel continue to supervise the signaling and interlocking systems, which remain partially manual. The implementation of PLC and SCADA can effectively address these challenges. The primary objective of this paper is to examine dispatcher telecommunications with crews, telecommunications with signals governing switchgears, signals monitoring track temperature, and the acquisition and storage of real-time video through CCTV for telecommunications in emergencies and automatic railway gates. The proposed solution depends on PLCs that can execute signaling and interlocking functions automatically. Moreover, these processes can be altered, monitored, and corrected through the use of a SCADA system, hence minimizing human participation and alleviating safety issues.

articleTitle: Enhanced Classification of Cricket Batting Shots Using Advanced Machine Learning and Computer Vision Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A novel method for categorizing cricket batting shots using machine learning and computer vision techniques. Our approach utilizes pose estimation using ViTPose for capturing player posture accurately while a shot is being played. The model takes an image as input, and accurately identifies the batsman. Keypoints obtained by applying the pre-trained ViTPose model on the input image is classified into one of four different shot categories. This finds application in sports analytics as well as smart bowling machines for continuous skill learning. The classification of cricket batting shots is difficult because of enormous variability in the techniques of players and their shot types. The existing methods do not have any feasible approach toward discrimination of different types of shots in dynamic environments. Therefore, this study meets the gap in the development of a robust automated system, which optimally categorizes cricket shots. This will be operationalized further using techniques such as pose estimation and object recognition, among many other machine learning and computer vision advancements, for the enhancement of shot classification in the realization of analytics and training applications in sports.

articleTitle: Optimized Electric Vehicle Charging with Intermittent Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The integration of intermittent renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind, into electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure presents a promising pathway to decarbonize the transportation sector and enhance energy sustainability. This paper investigates optimized charging strategies that align EV charging demand with the availability of renewable energy. By leveraging real-time data from renewable generation and applying advanced algorithms, such as demand-side management and smart grid control, the proposed method aims to minimize grid stress while maximizing the use of clean energy. The study highlights the technical challenges of managing fluctuations in renewable output and provides solutions for overcoming these issues, including battery storage, demand response techniques, and vehicle-to-grid (V2G) integration. Simulation results demonstrate the potential of these optimized charging strategies to reduce carbon emissions, lower electricity costs, and enhance grid reliability. This work contributes to the broader effort of promoting sustainable transportation and optimizing the synergy between EVs and renewable energy sources. Key findings include the benefits of flexible charging schedules and the role of V2G technology in stabilizing grid operations during peak renewable generation periods. This abstract summarizes the key aspects of optimized EV charging using renewable energy, focusing on reducing emissions and grid impact.

articleTitle: Optimizing E-Auction Systems with Cosine Similarity for Personalized Bidding
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Our system, the next-level E-auction platform offers a highly interactive and participant-oriented bidding experience. The basic idea behind the system is two-part: the first, there is collaborative filtering coupled with cosine similarity to generate personalized recommendations, whereby relevant product options are provided, based on personal preference and previous interactions of the user. A chatbot facilitates personalized communication that allows the users to inquire about product-related queries and receive instant assistance. From its own end, filtering products based on type allows users to refine their searches and actually interact with the auction by placing their bids. Therefore, it is a dynamic system that is quite transparent and has real interactivity to it, wherein the bid will get registered instantaneously. The system also features a dedicated backend interface for the administrator, which facilitates effective management of auctions; it also includes bid-setting limits and closes the auctions. Scalable by design, the E-Auction system blends real-time bidding, personalized recommendations, and secure backend control to ensure efficient user-friendly auctioning.

articleTitle: Hybrid Dadda-Capprox Multiplier Architecture for Energy-Efficient High-Speed CNN Processing in VLSI
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A New Dadda-Capprox multiplier that combines Dadda and Capprox multipliers can improve the energy and speed performance for CNN applications on VLSI circuits. Conventional multiplier structures may not achieve an optimal power-performance methodology, where speed is critical in CNN implementations. To overcome this issue, the hybrid multiplier that has been proposed incorporates the fast Dadda tree structure and the power-saving Capprox multiplier while adjusting the precision that is lost to gain a massive amount of efficiency. The experimental result provides a better improvement of 45.7% in energy efficiency and a 54.7% less PDP when compared with the conventional multiplier. Also, the hybrid architecture achieves a high CNN classification accuracy of 92.3% while operating at 8 bits of approximation, achieving fast execution and low power consumption. These effectiveness results reinforce that the proposed architecture may be useful for real-time, energy-restricted devices, as CNN execution on VLSI systems that require high operation efficiency for implementing specific tasks by addressing crucial concerns such as low power usage, size, and relatively high clock frequencies.

articleTitle: Optimizing Time Series Denoising with an Improved Singular Spectrum Analysis Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A time series is a two-dimensional dataset with an ordered sequence and a time. It represents the essential properties of the process and is applicable across various domains. Time series captured by sensors often include random oscillations that obscure the valuable insights. Denoising the time series aims to remove fluctuations and outliers. However, there are many challenges, as noise frequently overlaps with meaningful patterns. Existing approaches often fail to accomplish this task efficiently due to the non-stationary nature of the time series. Based on singular spectrum analysis, the proposed methodology successfully isolates signals from noise. The methodology breaks down time series into discrete components and selects only noise-free components. The proposed method is well-suited to complicated and dynamic data. When tested on two synthetic datasets, the proposed strategy outperforms existing approaches, keeping essential patterns while minimizing noise.

articleTitle: LLM driven Natural Language to SQL for Utility Dashboards
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Advancements in Natural Language to Structured Query Language (NL2SQL) systems are improving the accessibility of data stored in relational databases, making it easier for non-technical users to retrieve information using simple language queries. In this paper, we propose an NL2SQL system specifically designed for IoT-driven plant data applications, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with a multi-step training and evaluation process. This approach involves developing a context table and accompanying tag datasheet to represent IoT-specific data attributes, fine-tuning a LLM to enhance SQL query generation, and evaluating model performance using the ChatGPT API, comparing generated queries against standard metrics from the Spider dataset. Our methodology aims to address the complexities inherent in NL2SQL tasks involving IoT datasets, where queries are often complex and context specific. This research contributes a scalable and adaptable NL2SQL approach which is suited for IoT data environments.

articleTitle: Deep Learning in Neurovascular Health: A Review in Brain Stroke Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Brain stroke is a serious medical condition in which the blood flow in the brain is disrupted, resulting in considerable amount of damage and deadly effects to the individual. The research is focused on investigating the use of various machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches to predict brain strokes in a person based on his medical record and other factors associated with him. The study analyzes conventional diagnostic tools like Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Computed Tomography (CT), and EEG along with various advanced machine learning techniques like decision trees, logistic regression and ensemble models like Random Forest and Gradient Boosting for effective stroke prediction. These models can use various data points such as age, blood pressure, cholesterol levels, and medical history of the patient to predict the risk of stroke. The study reveals the use of predictive models to improve early stroke detection, allowing for prompt interventions that can improve recovery prospects and decrease the possibility of long-term disability. Moreover, the ability for deep learning algorithms to spot minute patterns in the brain imaging opens new possibilities for enhancing diagnostic accuracy. The study highlights the use of different datasets and predictive models with ML and DL to greatly enhance the stroke risk prediction. The research continues by highlighting the importance of future research to strengthen these models and add more data to improve stroke prediction. This study acts as a bridge between standard stroke diagnostic techniques and modern AI technology to improve healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: Term Deposit Customer Prediction: A Blending Approach Using Bank Marketing Data
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The global COVID-19 pandemic led to a significant economic downturn, severely impacting financial systems and economies around the world. Widespread lockdowns and travel restrictions disrupted supply chains, forced business closures, and triggered job losses, highlighting the importance of sound financial planning. Term deposits have emerged as a preferred strategy for risk mitigation. In marketing, direct customer outreach has increasingly replaced traditional intermediary-based approaches. Using data from a Portuguese bank, this study explores the predictive accuracy of various machine learning models in identifying customers most likely to invest in term deposits. Machine learning techniques applied include Support Vector Machine (SVM), Gaussian Naïve Bayes, bagging, blending, Light Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), bagging, and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). Results demonstrate that bagging algorithms provide superior accuracy in predicting customer behavior, offering insights to enhance targeted marketing efforts."

articleTitle: ML-based Sleep Disorder Identification for Athletic Performance Enhancement Using Wearables
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper describes the application of machine learning (ML) in sleep disorder diagnosis and monitoring of athlete activities by introducing new algorithms that classify data using K – Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Logistic Regression (LR), Naive Bayes (NB), and Random Forest (RF) to increase both the diagnostic and analytic capabilities of the system. Moreover, the developed application is supported by e-healthcare systems and smart dwelling environments to watch and evaluate sleep quality parameters and other measures important for athletics. Our study show that KNN managed a remarkable 93% accuracy, which was the best of all other models used in classifying sleep disorders, and performance measurement of the athletes was also easy. The opportunity to integrate with IoT gadgets further expands this by ensuring that data can be captured continuously and introducing a new dimension of preventive medicine, personalized medicine and even better training for the athletes. It is noted that the opportunity to use such systems at the interface of ML and connected health could potentially improve health delivery outcomes for patients and athletes while offering a cost-effective system for health monitoring.

articleTitle: InterviewEdge: A Smart Interview Assistant
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A structured, objective approach to non-coding technical interviews can enhance fairness and effectiveness in hiring, for which the latest AI technology can be applied instead of human evaluation. Towards this, this paper presents InterviewEdge: A Smart Interview Assistant, an AI-powered system designed to automate the evaluation of theoretical answers in programming languages. The proposed system employs Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies such as the Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and Large Language Model (LLM) for the retrieval of relevant content for technical assessment of the candidates’ responses. The proposed work is evaluated using criteria such as technical accuracy, response completeness, display of language-specific knowledge, and use of clarity & structure. InterviewEdge provides for unbiased evaluation by ensuring consistent marking of the responses. Feedback to the candidates may help them understand how to improve specific areas of their answers.

articleTitle: A Survey on Application of Computational Technique for Two Area Interconnected Automatic Generation Control in Power System Using PSO-PID
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper the various computational approaches for automatic generation control (AGC) of power systems is covers, with the goal of improving the automatic voltage regulator (AVR) and load frequency control (LFC) that are utilized with proportional integrative and derivatives (PID) controllers. PID tuning has long been a main area of current study, and PID controllers, sometimes known as proportional integrative and derivatives, are utilized in industry. The techniques being reviewed are conventional methods designed for PID based PSO optimization strategies that fit tuning requirements. Power engineering research and development now places a strong emphasis on optimization due to the growing requirement for energy. This paper deals on the electric power system applications of two area interconnected PSO based PID computational techniques to inspires power sector to uncover fresh information about the ideal rate of energy provision because of its creative application.

articleTitle: Design and Testing of Unmanned Surface Vehicle with Water Sampling Mechanism for measuring Water Quality
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper describes about the electronics system architecture of an unmanned surface vehicle (USV), which can gather data on water bodies such as lakes,ponds,rivers and oceans.The USV robot was created to measure water contamination and assist in enhancing the techniques now employed for this purpose.a multiparameter probe or container which holds water is used to measure conductivity, turbidity, pH, and temperature in relation to water quality. The vehicle's primary functions might be mapping newly discovered water bodies, measuring the pollution levels in the water, and routinely monitoring existing water bodies. The vehicle makes use of information obtained from taking water samples in the bodies of water. This information is useful for a variety of tasks, and mapping the water bodies can be accomplished through communication between several USVs.

articleTitle: Drone Delivery Route Optimization with Pathfinding using Swarm Intelligence (SI)
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Drone delivery systems are transforming logistics, promising swift and efficient transportation of goods. However, optimizing drone routes presents significant challenges, particularly in dynamic environments with varying obstacles and delivery points. This project explores the application of swarm intelligence techniques, specifically Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), to enhance drone delivery route efficiency. Swarm intelligence, inspired by natural behaviors of social insects and other animal groups, leverages decentralized and self-organized methodologies to solve complex problems. By studying the principles and mechanisms of ACO and PSO, this research aims to develop robust algorithms for drone pathfinding. ACO, mimicking the foraging behavior of ants, and PSO, inspired by the social dynamics of bird flocks and fish schools, offer unique advantages in navigating and adapting to environmental changes. The project involves setting up a simulation environment to test these algorithms, evaluating their performance based on metrics such as delivery time, route length, and computational efficiency. Preliminary results indicate that integrating swarm intelligence into drone delivery systems can significantly improve route optimization, making the delivery process more efficient and resilient. This research not only contributes to the field of logistics and transportation but also demonstrates the potential of bio-inspired algorithms in solving real-world engineering problems. Future work will focus on refining these algorithms and expanding their applications to more complex and large-scale delivery scenarios.

articleTitle: Smart Fault maintenance and Pay-Activated Laundry System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This project is designed to convert the traditional washing machines into smart, pay-activated machines using an integrated web application and NodeMCU microcontroller. The system enables users to remotely control the washing machine through a web interface, allowing selection of washing option and processing payments based on the chosen duration. Upon successful payment, the machine is activated automatically. The NodeMCU acts as the core controller, managing communication between the web app and the washing machine. The system also incorporates fault detection by utilizing sensors to monitor the machine's real-time performance. If a fault occurs, users are immediately notified through alerts, enabling timely maintenance. Additionally, users receive notifications upon completion of the wash cycle. The key features of the system include remote control via a web interface, integrated payment processing, real-time fault detection, and user notifications. This smart solution enhances user convenience, improves operational efficiency, and minimizes downtime, making it highly suitable for commercial laundry operations.

articleTitle: Cloud-Enabled Machine Learning System for Real-Time Health Monitoring of Cardiac Patients
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Heart disease remains a leading cause of mortality worldwide, highlighting the need for advanced health monitoring systems for timely intervention. This paper presents PulseGuard, a cloud-enabled machine learning framework for real-time cardiac monitoring. Using cloud infrastructure, PulseGuard integrates wearable devices to continuously collect and analyze patient data, enabling immediate detection of heart irregularities. The system's machine learning models provide responsive anomaly detection, alerting healthcare providers promptly during critical events. Its cloud-based architecture ensures scalability, supporting many patients without sacrificing real-time processing. The experimental evaluations show a 97% accuracy in detecting cardiac anomalies with a detection latency of under one second, outperforming traditional methods in precision and speed. This quick response is crucial in emergencies, reducing time to intervention and potentially enhancing patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Integrated and Intelligent Elder-Friendly E-commerce Framework using NLP Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: All over the world, the population of elderly people is increasing a lot. There needs to be special attention to the welfare of the elderly person to make them confident in their independent quality of living. In recent years, researchers have shown much interest in smart home automation for people who live alone without any human assistance. However, the purchase of medical drugs, diapers, etc., outside the house has to be fulfilled by their family members or caretakers. In most cases, it is not feasible, as the family members may stay long away from the elders. Purchasing online is easy; however, analyzing the best product requires knowledge in each e-commerce application for better quality at a low cost. This paper proposes an integrated and intelligent e-commerce framework to avoid the drawback of purchasing items online in a single window using the NLP technique. The proposed framework provides offers, discounts, star ratings, and product reviews by analyzing other customers’ review data and purchase patterns. It provides interactive data analysis at a single window for the ease of elderly persons. The performance of the proposed framework was evaluated by 120 elderly persons using a simple questionnaire with a statistical analysis of a sample purchase.

articleTitle: Hydro-Environmental Autonomous Cleaning System (HEACS)
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The Hydro-Environmental Autonomous Cleaning System (HEACS) addresses the critical issue of water pollution by autonomously collecting waste from water bodies and monitoring water quality. This system integrates a conveyor belt mechanism powered by DC motors for efficient waste collection, including oil spills. Water quality is maintained using Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) sensors, which trigger the injection of purifying chemicals like 777 Bioconcentrate, chlorine dioxide, Copper Sulphate, or Aluminium Sulphate when necessary. Collected garbage weight is measured using load sensors, with real-time data displayed on an LCD connected to an Arduino Uno. Autonomous navigation and operation are managed via Rx/Tx modules, ensuring effective performance in various environmental conditions. HEACS offers a comprehensive solution for water pollution control, combining automation, effective waste management, and environmental monitoring to protect aquatic ecosystems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Task Scheduling in Cloud-Fog Environments with Improved Butterfly Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Task scheduling in cloud-fog computing is challenging, particularly for large-scale Bag-of-Jobs (BoJ) applications. To address this complexity, we propose a new task-scheduling model that balances execution speed and cost efficiency. This model employs the Butterfly Swarm Optimization (BSO) algorithm, designed explicitly for cloud-fog systems, allowing end-users to choose between prioritizing lower latency or minimizing costs. In our study, we compared BSO’s performance with the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Bee Life Algorithm (BLA) across different datasets, considering various quality of service (QoS) parameters. Experimental outcomes demonstrate that BSO consistently outperforms the other algorithms by effectively balancing time and cost, enhancing QoS, and overall system efficiency. As a result, BSO is a highly effective solution for task scheduling in cloud-fog settings, leading to improved system responsiveness and a better user experience.

articleTitle: Human Drawing-Driven Automated Evaluation for Parkinson's Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Globally, Parkinson's Disease is the second most prevalent neurodegenerative disorder, which is identified by distinct symptoms like tremors, bradykinesia, rigidity, and postural instability. Early signs may include reduced facial expression, impaired hand-eye coordination, and decreased muscle-brain coordination. As PD progresses, symptoms worsen, potentially leading to severe disability. Although there is no cure, early detection and intervention can improve patient outcomes. Traditional PD diagnosis methods, involving clinical assessments and neurological tests, are often time-consuming and subjective. Machine Learning (ML) provides a promising alternative for automating PD detection using data-driven algorithms. This paper explores various ML methods, including Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Linear Discriminant Analysis, Random Forest, Gaussian Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and Support Vector Classifier (SVC), to predict early-stage PD symptoms. After experiments, the Gaussian Naive Bayes model scored the highest accuracy of 78%, showcasing the potential of ML to improve early detection.

articleTitle: EDUVERSE: Inclusive and Immersive Metaverse Learning Environment for Education
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Eduverse is an advanced Virtual Reality (VR) platform developed to transform traditional education by creating interactive and immersive virtual learning environments. Designed to support both students and teachers, Eduverse simulates real-world classrooms, discussion rooms, and conference halls, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. One of its standout features is the accessibility tools, such as text-to-speech (TTS) and speech-to-text (STT) systems, which make the platform highly beneficial for students with disabilities. The TTS system helps students with speech impairments by converting their typed messages into spoken words, while the STT system transcribes spoken communication into text for students who have difficulty hearing.In addition to accessibility, Eduverse offers customizable avatars, allowing students to represent themselves digitally, which helps reduce social anxiety and encourages participation. The platform also provides teachers with speech management tools, enabling them to moderate discussions, assign speaking privileges, and manage class activities. This ensures that every student has the opportunity to contribute, even in larger classes. Eduverse has been tested within a set of students, showing significant improvements in student engagement, participation, and inclusivity compared to traditional online learning platforms. Students with disabilities reported that the integrated accessibility tools allowed them to engage more fully in class discussions, making Eduverse a valuable solution for inclusive education. By combining a collaborative and supportive learning space, Eduverse demonstrates the potential to improve the way students learn and interact in the virtual world.

articleTitle: Framework for Cloud-Based Data Management in Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The increasing adoption of autonomous vehicles has driven the need for robust data management solutions that support real-time operations and ensure vehicle safety and efficiency. This work introduces a cloud-based framework for management of sensor data from autonomous vehicles, focusing on optimizing payload transmission rates. The framework leverages AWS IoT Core and AWS IoT Analytics to ensure efficient data flow from vehicle sensors to cloud storage. This framework demonstrates its potential for scalable deployment in real-world autonomous vehicle networks, contributing to the evolution of connected vehicle technologies and intelligent transport systems. This framework ensures reliable data transmission up to 250 payloads per second, beyond which data loss occurs.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Driven Landslide Detection System Using Optimized AlexNet
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Landslip detection is a key duty in disaster management, necessitating quick and precise diagnosis to avoid loss of life and property. This work describes a deep learning-driven landslip detection system based on an optimized AlexNet architecture. The suggested method improves the traditional AlexNet model by employing optimization strategies targeted at increasing detection accuracy while decreasing computing complexity. The method detects landslides from satellite and aerial imagery more effectively after fine-tuning the network’s hyperparameters and including additional layers for feature extraction. Comprehensive trials on benchmark landslide datasets reveal that the optimized AlexNet model achieves an accuracy of 92.1%, significantly outperforming standard machine learning (ML) approaches. The model’s precision, recall, and F1-score for landslide detection are 0.88, 0.85, and 0.86, respectively, while for non-landslides, these metrics are 0.94, 0.96, and 0.95, respectively. The system’s efficient processing capability qualifies it for real-time applications, making it a promising solution for large-scale landslip monitoring and early warning systems. This paper adds to the expanding body of research on deep learning-based disaster management systems by introducing a robust, scalable, and efficient landslip detection framework.

articleTitle: Interactive Physiotherapy Game Using React Three Fiber for Hand Motion Rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This article describes an interactive physical activity system designed to use React Three Fiber to assist patients with hand rehabilitation. The game simulates a virtual environment where rods controlled by motion-sensing devices represent the patient’s hand. Through the "Create" function, a sphere can be created from the previous position and the patient must hold their hand firmly within the sphere’s boundaries. Adjustable sliders allow optimal control of hold time and sensitivity to adapt to the patient’s growth and treatment needs. The game provides immediate visual feedback, encouraging patients to practice stability and mobility, which are essential elements of good physical therapy. The app simulates real-world movements in a virtual environment, creating a controlled environment that provides immediate visual feedback to encourage patients to take action. This technology uses React Three Fiber to create a 3D environment, including writing information for precise control of the stick. This interactive model is designed to not only develop motor skills through consistent, guided exercises, but also to improve overall patient compliance. Through this application, we explore the intersection of play and physical therapy by examining the potential for digital therapy tools to complement and enhance traditional practices This approach uses the appeal of interactive games to potentially increase treatment compliance, making it an important tool in digital therapy. This article discusses the use of React Three Fiber’s techniques, methods, and therapeutic potential for physical therapy.

articleTitle: Smart Shelf Monitoring Using YOLO
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: As modern retail processes are rapidly developing; inventory management becomes one of the key factors affecting the client’s needs and business competitiveness. The merchandising concept of product accessibility on the shelves contributes significantly to customers’ attitude and the retailer patronage. But the conventional methods of tracking inventories are inadequate in responding to the challenges of the dynamic retail setting thereby leading to problem such as stock-out and ineffective restocking. To address these challenges, this system harnesses the state-of-the-art YOLO algorithm to transform inventory control. By observing live camera feeds within stores, it predicts available shelf spaces, which list the products that are either low or out of stock in the store. In this continuous shelf monitoring perspective, one can easily anticipate shelf items which are running low so that immediate action for restocking is awakened. It also eradicating the feelings made by customers whenever they are faced with scenarios, such as having to walk past shelves that have no products. Moreover, it helps store personnel actively and accurately replenish all stock, making products available at all times thanks to notifications.

articleTitle: Cultural Representation in Indian Animation: A Review of Themes and Narratives
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Cultural representation in Indian animation plays a vital role in storytelling, reflecting the nation’s heritage and diverse identities. This paper explores the evolution of cultural themes in Indian animation, which preserves heritage and imparts values through mythology, folklore, and contemporary narratives. From early storytelling roots to modern series like Chhota Bheem and films such as Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama, Indian animation highlights India’s cultural diversity. Despite challenges like limited regional representation and heavy reliance on mythology, the industry has grown, reaching global audiences through streaming platforms and fostering cross-cultural understanding. By analyzing themes of mythology, folklore, and social values alongside case studies, this paper reveals how Indian animation shapes identity, fosters pride, and balances tradition with modernity. Indian animation thus stands as a powerful medium for cultural diplomacy, education, and entertainment.

articleTitle: GRU in Anomaly Detection for IoT: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we present a comparative analysis of Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) models against other deep learning architectures, particularly focusing on anomaly detection and failure prediction within IoT-based industrial systems. GRU’s simplified structure, which accelerates training and reduces memory usage, makes it well-suited for real-time applications in IoT, outperforming its Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) counterparts in many cases. However, its limitations in handling long-term dependencies, noisy data, and larger datasets can impede performance in more complex scenarios. Several studies have explored hybrid models that combine GRU with architectures like Transformers and CNNs to improve accuracy, especially in environments with irregular and noisy data. This paper discusses the computational efficiency of GRU and its application in edge computing while addressing its weaknesses through hybrid approaches. By leveraging insights from recent literature and projects, we evaluate GRU’s effectiveness in IoT applications and propose a hybrid GRU-Transformer model to enhance anomaly detection capabilities.

articleTitle: An extensive critique of various modern optimization techniques for electric vehicles and their applications
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The rapid advancement of electric vehicles (EVs) has prompted significant research into optimizing their performance, efficiency, and integration into smart grid systems. This paper provides an extensive critique of modern optimization techniques applied to EVs, covering areas such as battery management, energy consumption, routing, and charging infrastructure. We analyze both traditional and emerging optimization methods, including heuristic algorithms, machine learning approaches, and hybrid techniques. The paper evaluates these methods in terms of computational efficiency, scalability, adaptability, and real-world applicability. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and future directions for optimizing EVs in the context of evolving technologies and infrastructures. By synthesizing the latest research findings, this critique aims to offer a comprehensive understanding of the strengths and limitations of various optimization strategies, providing valuable insights for researchers, engineers, and policymakers involved in the development and deployment of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Advanced Navigation and Payload Systems for Underground Drone Operations
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper explores advancements in underground drone technology, focusing on key systems that enable navigation, sensing, and communication in GPS-denied environments. It covers the integration of GPS, cameras, LiDAR, and inertial navigation systems, highlighting how each technology contributes to effective drone operations in complex underground settings. The payload capabilities, including sampling tools, robotic arms, and advanced sensors, enable diverse applications, from mining and environmental monitoring to infrastructure inspection. Furthermore, the study discusses an iterative optimization algorithm for task offloading and resource allocation within multi-drone networks, enhancing computational efficiency. By merging data from multiple sensors and applying innovative mapping techniques, these drones achieve precise navigation and obstacle avoidance. This work underscores the role of customizable payloads in expanding drone utility and ensuring operational efficiency, offering valuable insights for future developments in autonomous underground systems.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach to Sign Language Recognition Using MediaPipe and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper provides an efficient and accurate sign language recognition system in real time that understands gestures employed using MediaPipe and Random Forest in American Sign Language (ASL). The system captures and processes hand gestures in real time, allowing for optimized responses on the trained dataset with the extended feature for a user to create its own database in just a few clicks. MediaPipe framework is designed to provide powerful hand tracking abilities and is used to capture and refine landmarks which in turn contributes in improving gesture recognition accuracy. The processed data which is captured with OpenCV library is fed into the model trained on the dataset created by authors resulting in 99.81% accuracy in recognizing hand gestures. The findings emphasize the system’s potential applications in communication, education, and accessibility, emphasizing its importance for people who have hearing impairments. The combination of MediaPipe with Random Forest and CNN provides a practical solution for a precise real-time sign language detection with a user-friendly model.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Lightweight Authentication Mechanisms for Vehicle Group Communication in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: High-speed and ultra-low latency communication enabled by 5G technology will change vehicular network programs which demand robust group authentication to protect V2X (vehicle-to-everything) communications against cyberattacks. This survey reviews state-of-the-art lightweight authentication protocols for 5G vehicular applications showing technology that stands out due to its security, scalability, and efficiency. ECC, chaotic maps and dynamic key management are some important techniques, but they can provide mutual authentication with low computational load. The survey compares these protocols based on speed, privacy, and resource usage to reveal two aspects: (1) challenges of each protocol for which no solutions exist together with the suitable whistle-blowing sponsors towards 5G vehicular networks, and (2) possible paths that may be considered as solutions for scalable secured group authentication.

articleTitle: Advanced Semantic Segmentation of Flooded Regions in UAV Imagery Using a Modified U-Net Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Flood image segmentation has a significant role in disaster management since it can spot and accurately predict flooded regions from aerial and satellite imagery. UAVs have proven to be invaluable tools, which provide extensive data contributing to higher evaluation of the impact of floods. This paper proposes modern deep learning techniques and advanced image processing methods for segmentation using U-Net and its modified architecture. We have improved the model by increasing layers, the filter size and normalization of the activation function to yield more accurate output, thus providing better segmentation results. Therefore, a comparative analysis reveals that the modified U-Net model performs better for the task of flood segmentation because it provides a precision value of 0.9280, a recall value of 0.9910, an IoU of 0.9203 and an overall accuracy of 0.9587.

articleTitle: Stock Market Insights Using Basic Recurrent Neural Networks Models
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Using a confusion matrix-based methodology, this study explores the use of Simple RNNs for stock price forecasting. Our technology generates accurate forecasts by examining past data to reveal hidden trends and patterns. The model’s strong points and opportunities for development are reveal by a careful analysis of the confusion matrix. To assess the model’s performance, we categorize continuous price predictions into discrete bins. Our findings suggest that Simple RNNs are effective in predicting these prices. The study adds to the expanding body of research on the application of deep neural architecture in the financial sector.

articleTitle: Transforming Hospital Visitor Screening with Cloud-Powered Deep Learning for Safety and Security
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This research describes a novel approach to hospital visitor screening utilizing cloud-powered deep learning using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Our proposed approach will fill this need by improving threat detection accuracy and decreasing false positives. Our system can successfully detect possible dangers among visitors by using CNNs, renowned for their ability to perform image recognition tasks. Integrating cloud computing also makes scalability, real-time processing, and centralized administration possible across several hospital locations. This rigorous testing and evaluation technique improves hospital security requirements reliably and resiliently. It presents novel methods to transform visitor screening fundamentally, solving the challenge of keeping patients, staff, and facilities secure from evolving dangers. The proposed method greatly improves hospital security since it might increase safety and reduce dangers.

articleTitle: DeepSDC: An Efficient Deep Neural Network based Spinal Disease Classification using ResNet152 Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Spinal column disorders, such as ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and scoliosis, are increasingly common due to lifestyle changes, affecting 5% and 3% of the population, respectively. These conditions can arise in childhood and, without treatment maylead to discomfort and severe complications, including lung and heart problems in advanced scoliosis. Early detection is an effective treatment and prevention of progression. Traditional diagnosis involves visual evaluations of radiographs and angle measurements, such as the Cobbangle, but AI-based systems still require labor intensive and error-prone evaluations by professionals. To address these issues, automated X-ray image processing systems have been developed. This study applies residual deep-transfer learning to detect AS and scoliosis, eliminating manual assessments. A data set from 338 individuals, including scoliosis, spondylolisthesis, and healthy subjects, achieved a mean precision and efficiency of 100

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Alzheimer’s Disease Diagnosis: A Review of Recent Advancements, Obstacles, and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a common chronic ailment that predominantly affects elderly people. AD is a neurological condition that causes a steady deterioration in cognitive function.
