There is no cure for AD; however, early detection and timely treatment can slow its progression. The development and implementation of artificial intelligence (AI) technology in medicine has greatly improved the accuracy and precision of the detection and diagnosis of AD. Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models have grown in popularity in recent years, particularly for medical image analysis. The application of ML and DL approaches to diagnose AD has grown significantly in recent years. This study reviews numerous studies from 2020 to 2024 that used ML and DL to detect AD. It gives a complete review of the ML/DL models used in these studies, as well as their limitations and future prospects.

articleTitle: The implementation of sign language interpreter with modified RNN for speech and hearing impaired
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Communication barriers faced by speech and hearing-impaired individuals often limit their interaction with the broader society. The intelligent sign language interpreter system revolutionizes communication for the speech and hearing-impaired community. Utilizing advanced neural networks, this innovative technology recognizes and translates hand gestures into text or speech in real-time, promoting effortless interactions. With its custom-designed RNN architecture, extensive dataset training, and enhanced preprocessing techniques, this portable and user-friendly solution bridges communication gaps in social and professional settings, empowering individuals to communicate confidently. By breaking down these barriers, the interpreter system unlocks new possibilities for social and economic inclusion. Individuals can now navigate everyday situations with greater ease, from ordering food to participating in meetings. The technology also opens doors to education and employment opportunities, enabling the speech and hearing-impaired community to reach their full potential. With its potential to transform lives, this groundbreaking system is poised to make a lasting impact on the lives of millions worldwide, fostering a more inclusive and equitable society. The system's advanced technology ensures accuracy and reliability, providing a seamless experience for users. Its ability to learn and adapt to different sign language dialects and regional variations enables widespread adoption. Additionally, the system's portability and affordability make it accessible to individuals and organizations worldwide, regardless of geographical or financial constraints.

articleTitle: Synergistic Energy Integration: Power Generation, Biofuel Production and Methane Pyrolysis
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This innovative concept presents a sustainable energy production system that converges power generation and biofuel production. The process initiates with the conversion of biological waste into biogas, is then pressurized and directed to a turbine connected to both a gas collector tank and a generator. The rotating turbine blades generate electricity, linking seamlessly to a Power Plant Controller (PPC) and integrating with the power grid. Simultaneously, residual biogas is directed to serve dual purposes-fuelling industrial needs while being channelled into a Methane Pyrolysis Tank. The Methane Pyrolysis Tank facilitates the separation of methane into hydrogen and carbon. The resulting hydrogen is stored for future energy use, while the carbon is stored for potential applications. This multifaceted system maximizes efficiency by harnessing generated biogas for both power generation and biofuel utilization.

articleTitle: Enhancing IoT ECO System - Smart Parking System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The Smart Parking System is an innovative solution designed to tackle the challenges of parking in densely populated urban areas. By integrating advanced technologies such as RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) sensors, automated gate systems, and proximity sensors, the system delivers a streamlined and efficient parking experience. RFID technology automates entry and exit processes by recognizing vehicles equipped with RFID tags, reducing wait times and enhancing security through controlled access. Proximity sensors at each parking spot monitor occupancy in real-time, feeding data to a central management system that directs drivers to available spaces via digital signage or a mobile app. This real-time guidance decreases search time, reduces congestion, and improves overall parking organization. Designed with scalability and future-readiness, the system's central management unit can integrate additional features like payment processing, reservation systems, and predictive analytics powered by machine learning. This adaptability ensures the system remains relevant as technology advances and user needs evolve. The Smart Parking System also promotes sustainability by minimizing vehicle idling and carbon emissions, contributing to a reduced environmental impact. For users, the system offers a more convenient, secure, and efficient parking experience. For operators, it enhances operational efficiency, reduces manual labor, and provides valuable insights into parking patterns, aiding in pricing, expansion, and maintenance decisions. The system's modular design allows for cost-effective implementation, making it suitable for various facilities from small lots to large complexes. In summary, the Smart Parking System represents a forward-thinking approach to urban parking, combining technology, efficiency, and sustainability to improve urban living.

articleTitle: Graph Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Personalized Dietary Guidance with LLMs
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents a personalized diet recommendation system that leverages a graph database and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with large language models (LLMs) to provide accurate and tailored nutritional plans. The system focuses on vegetarian Indian dishes and analyzes individual health metrics such as physical activity levels, weight age and height to generate customized diet plans. A Neo4j graph database, built from scraped recipe data, stores dish names, ingredients, and nutritional values, enabling precise information retrieval via LLMs. Additionally, the system provides nutritional details and overall health assessments of the dishes. To enhance overall health, the system also suggests basic workout plans based on users' physical metrics and dietary recommendations. This approach aims to provide a low-cost, accessible alternative to traditional diet consultations while mitigating hallucinations in AI outputs through RAG and structured data.

articleTitle: Early Autism Diagnosis in Children through Facial Image Recognition Using Refined Gravitational Search Optimized MobileNetv2 model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The complicated neuro developmental illness known as autism spectrum disorder (ASD) frequently appears in early childhood and has an impact on social interactions and communication. Timely intervention improves the long-term results and depends on early detection. This work investigates the use of deep learning models to automatically identify autism in children by analysing facial image data. Following the collection of facial image data, the pre-processing stage uses data normalisation and augmentation to improve the dataset's variability and consistency while reducing over fitting problems. Histogram equalisation is used for feature extraction to enhance the contrast of face images, which makes it easier to depict the facial traits that are essential for a precise diagnosis. The detection procedure makes use of Refined gravitational search optimized MobileNetV2 (RGSO-MobileNetV2) model, which combines RGSO method with MobileNetV2's lightweight design to improve image classification performance. The proposed model is assessed on various types of metrics, including F1-score (97.8%), recall (97.5%), accuracy (98%), and precision (97%). The importance of the suggested methodology is demonstrated by the experimental results, which show excellent accuracy and robustness in identifying autism in children and supporting early intervention efforts. According to the results, incorporating deep learning techniques into clinical settings could assist detect autism earlier and assist early intervention plans that improve the developmental paths of impacted kids.

Author Keywords: Refined Gravitational Search Optimized MobileNet V2 (RGSO-MobileNet V2)

articleTitle: Multimodal Emotion Analysis Using Attention-Based Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Emotions largely contribute to natural human-computer interaction, yet the nuanced nature of human expressions poses significant challenges. The proposed work presents a novel multimodal emotion analysis architecture. It is an attention-based neural network architecture that leverages audio, text, and visual features extracted as Wav2Vec 2.0 embeddings, All-MiniLM-L6-V2 based rich textual embeddings and ResNet-50 based visual embeddings. The evaluation of the proposed work is carried out on Multimodal Emotion Lines Dataset (MELD). The proposed architecture outperforms state-of-the-arts by significant margin by capturing contextual and temporal dependencies for individual modality followed by multi-head attention based efficient fusion. Its performance is measured in terms of accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score. Code is available at https://github.com/chhavidhiman1/Multimodal-Emotion-Analysis-

articleTitle: Study of the Movements of Active Upper Limb Prostheses
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The absence or amputation of an arm presents a significant difficulty, greatly reducing an individual’s autonomy and hindering daily tasks. Current prosthetic devices fail to address user needs, particularly due to insufficient tactile feedback, which limits their grasping capabilities. This paper conducts a thorough literature review on active upper limb prostheses, analyzing movement dynamics and user requirements. It emphasizes key shortcomings in existing prostheses regarding user satisfaction during daily activities and highlights factors contributing to the high rate of device abandonment. The overarching goal is to drive advancements in prosthetic development by improving user satisfaction and creating a prosthetic hand that more closely mimics natural human function. A collection of criteria for upper limb prosthetics is suggested, informed by movement analysis and tailored to user requirements. The objectives are to (i) offer recommendations to enhance prosthetic performance by considering both hand functionality and technical characteristics; (ii) introduce a prosthetic design that optimizes dexterity and mobility; and (iii) refine methods for evaluating user satisfaction with prosthetic devices, thereby offering a clearer understanding of user experience and device performance. These improvements could lead to prostheses that offer greater utility and user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Brake Smart: Harnessing IoT and Ultrasonic Technology for Collision-Free Driving
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This project aims to develop an advanced Automatic Braking System (ABS), called “BrakeSmart”, which leverages ultrasonic sensor technology to enhance road safety and prevent collisions. The system automatically applies the brakes to maintain a safe distance from the vehicle ahead. By continuously monitoring the distance using ultrasonic sensors, BrakeSmart engages the brakes when the distance falls below a predetermined threshold. This automation mitigates the limitations of human reaction time, significantly reducing the risk of collisions and promoting safer driving. Overall, this innovative technology marks a significant advancement in driver assistance systems, focusing on accident prevention and minimizing human error.

articleTitle: Wellness AI: AI-Driven Personalized Diet and Fitness Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Wellness AI is a health, fitness and lifestyle recommendation platform designed to process direct prompts that contain user information, such as age, gender, dietary preferences, and lifestyle choices. The system integrates real-time health metrics from Apple HealthKit, enabling more comprehensive insights by including user’s vitals. Using advanced fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and quantization techniques, the platform achieves high efficiency and accuracy. This paper details the technical components, training methods, and model optimization approaches used to streamline personalized health insights.

articleTitle: Enhanced Model for Mango Detection and Quality Classification Using Optimized Feature Extraction Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper introduces an automated grading system for mangoes, enhancing efficiency and accuracy compared to human-based methods. The system uses the Lion Assisted Firefly Algorithm (LA-FF) to extract the best features from multiple highlights, enhancing grading efficiency and accuracy. The LA-FF algorithm is then used to fine-tune the convolutional layers of a deep CNN based on the specific requirements of mango grading. The system integrates the latest algorithms, automation, and adaptation to create an even more effective and precise grading system suitable for rural agricultural contexts. The LA-FF algorithm is used to extract the best features from multiple highlights, resulting in a more accurate and efficient grading process.

articleTitle: Streamlining Kubernetes Deployments through GitOps Methodologies
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A clear process for automating the deployment of apps on Kubernetes using GitOps concepts is shown, with an emphasis on tools like Helm and Argo CD. The method demonstrates how to improve the effectiveness and reliability of application delivery by utilizing techniques like infrastructure- as-code, YAML configuration files, and CI/CD pipelines through GitHub Actions. The entities can accomplish reliable and repeatable deployments while developing teamwork among development teams by considering Git as the primary source of information. Applications remain in their original state with the support of Argo CD's continuous delivery, and monitoring tools provide data that is insightful on resource use and performance. By optimizing the management of cloud-native apps, our research helps people remain effective in the face of rapidly evolving technology. All things considered, the results demonstrate how applying GitOps techniques can streamline deployment procedures and improve application management in Kubernetes systems.

articleTitle: Intelligent control algorithms for industrial automation systems
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Industrial automation has become a cornerstone of modern manufacturing, enhancing efficiency, reliability, and scalability. The integration of intelligent control algorithms, such as fuzzy logic, neural networks, genetic algorithms, and model predictive control, has revolutionized traditional automation systems, enabling more adaptive, efficient, and robust operations. This paper explores the application and impact of these intelligent control techniques in industrial settings. It highlights how machine learning algorithms can predict equipment failures, optimize processes, and enhance decision-making in real-time. Case studies are presented to illustrate the benefits and challenges of deploying these algorithms across various automated systems, such as robotic assembly lines, process control in chemical plants, and smart warehousing. Furthermore, the paper discusses the integration of these algorithms with industrial IoT (IIoT) platforms, facilitating seamless communication and data exchange between machines and control systems. The research also addresses the challenges of implementing intelligent control, such as computational complexity, security concerns, and the need for real-time processing. Finally, this study evaluates future trends, emphasizing the potential of combining artificial intelligence and deep learning techniques with industrial automation for a more adaptive and autonomous manufacturing ecosystem.

articleTitle: EventOrchestr8: A Blockchain-Based, Secure QR Code Ticketing System using Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: EventOrchestr8 introduces a blockchain-based secure QR ticketing system with cryptographic encryption platform focused on security, transparency, and scalability. The system leverages the Ethereum blockchain and IPFS for decentralized metadata storage, where IPFS stores event and user-specific information essential for generating a unique ticket ID. Each ticket ID is derived using SHA hashing, with AES encryption and HMAC-SHA used to secure QR code generation and validation. Upon ticket purchase, metadata is stored on IPFS, and ticket details is registered on the blockchain through smart contracts, ensuring integrity and resistance to tampering. QR code validation at event entry involves decrypting the embedded QR data using various algorithms and verifying it against IPFS metadata. The ticket status is then updated on the blockchain to prevent reuse. This cryptographically enhanced approach provides a user-friendly yet secure solution for both event organizers and attendees, protecting against duplication and unauthorized access.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Meteorological Data Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Anomaly detection is a very important component in weather forecasting, disaster preparedness and climate modeling in meteorology. We use Density Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise, Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor, Elliptic Envelope and One Class Support Vector Machine to detect anomalies in Tunisian meteorological data in this study. Key meteorological parameters, such as wind speed, rainfall and temperature, was analyzed as the important indicators of atmospheric conditions. DBSCAN detected local density changes very well and is therefore a good choice for anomaly detection in areas with complex spatial patterns from the models used. Isolation Forest algorithm was able to find global anomalies with robust performance, giving very high true positive rates with minimum false positives. The use of these machine learning techniques is complementary and this dual approach shows how they can be used to detect different kinds of anomalies. The results show how machine learning can be used to make environmental monitoring and weather prediction much more accurate and reliable, with the ability to detect anomalies precisely and reliably. Having such capabilities is critical for taking proactive actions in response to extreme weather events, and to be able to intervene at the right time to minimize the impacts of the events. Additionally, these models could be integrated into real time monitoring systems to provide additional utility in optimizing their use and provide actionable insight for disaster management and climate resilience. Further research could involve the fusion of these algorithms with deep learning methods, larger datasets, and real time deployment to build intelligent systems that can learn and adapt to changing environmental conditions. This would be a large advance in applying machine learning in meteorology.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Decision Making in Smart Health and Emergency Management
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Phenomena such as smart health and emergency management systems when embedded with data-driven decision-making have become a game-changer in the field of healthcare and an emergency response. In this paper, we investigate the use of advanced data analytics, machine learning algorithms and real-time data processing in improving decision-making activities in these domains. Using data from a diverse set of large datasets such as EHRs, wearables, emergency response systems etc., we hope to build predictive models and decision support systems which can help save lives by predicting the epidemic before it peaks saving valuable time when every minute counts. The research also deals with issues such as data privacy, interoperability and real-time data integration. Early findings suggest large efficiencies and effectiveness gains in health and emergency management, showing the game-changing potential of datadriven solutions in their domains.

articleTitle: Integrated Farm Security System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: India's agriculture, the nation's largest industry, faces significant challenges due to current economic conditions, with crop loss from man-wildlife conflicts being a pressing issue. Traditional methods like employing guards have proven inadequate and unsustainable. This technical abstract proposes a technology-driven solution to safeguard crops, wildlife, and human welfare. By deploying an advanced setup integrating machine learning and computer vision, the system can detect and identify animals and humans in agricultural areas, enabling proactive measures to prevent crop damage. Sophisticated algorithms differentiate between various threats, allowing targeted, ethical responses that prioritize coexistence. This approach addresses immediate challenges while contributing to the long-term sustainability of agriculture and biodiversity conservation. Continuous monitoring and collaboration among farmers, wildlife conservationists, and technology experts aim to establish a holistic framework for managing man-wildlife conflicts in Indian agriculture, ensuring the well-being of both humans and wildlife.

articleTitle: TechAssist: A RAG-Based Chatbot for Accessing Technical Information from StackOverflow
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents TechAssist, an advanced artificial intelligence-driven chatbot designed to enhance the learning experience for students and professionals in tech domain. Utilizing the Mistral 7B Instruct model within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, TechAssist efficiently retrieves and generates contextually relevant answers to technical queries sourced from the StackOverflow dataset. Implemented with a user-friendly interface using Gradio, the system provides real-time responses, facilitating interactive engagement for users seeking technical support. Evaluation with learners and educators demonstrates the efficacy of TechAssist in delivering accurate and timely information, significantly improving the speed and quality of assistance. The findings indicate that the integration of cutting-edge AI technologies with an intuitive interface result in a more effective learning environment and enhanced user empowerment in addressing technical challenges.

articleTitle: Advanced Spam Detection Techniques in Social Media: A Comprehensive Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The rapid growth of social media platforms has led to increased spam content, ranging from unwanted advertisements to harmful misinformation, negatively affecting user experience and platform security. Traditional spam detection methods often need to address the evolving complexity of spam tactics. This study explores advanced spam detection techniques using machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL). We propose a structured framework involving pre-processing, feature extraction, and model training to enhance detection accuracy. We evaluate algorithms such as decision trees, ensemble models, and neural networks, examining their strengths and limitations in classifying spam. Our findings show that advanced ML and DL techniques outperform traditional methods, providing more efficient and accurate spam detection. This study offers valuable insights for improving spam detection systems, ensuring safer social media environments and paving the way for future research combating spam online.

articleTitle: Smart Environmental Monitoring System for Air and Water Quality Index
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The quality of air and water is essential for human health, environmental sustainability, and ecosystem balance. However, pollution from industrial activities, urbanization, and agricultural practices has made effective environmental monitoring a global priority. Traditional monitoring methods, which rely on manual sampling and laboratory analysis, are often time-consuming and lack real-time capabilities. This paper presents a Smart Environmental Monitoring (SEM) system leveraging IoT and sensor technology to monitor air and water quality in real time using two key sensors: the MQ135 for Air Quality Index (AQI) and the pH sensor for Water Quality Index (WQI). By focusing on these two critical parameters, the SEM system offers a streamlined yet robust solution for assessing environmental quality. The system collects data continuously, transmits it to a cloud platform for processing, and employs machine learning algorithms to forecast future pollution trends. A user-friendly dashboard displays real-time AQI and WQI levels, historical trends, and predictive insights, empowering users to respond proactively to environmental risks. Deployment results demonstrate the SEM system’s capability in detecting pollution patterns, identifying high-risk areas, and predicting pollution spikes during peak traffic and in industrial zones. Comparative analysis with traditional monitoring highlights the SEM system’s superior accuracy, scalability, and predictive abilities. Although the SEM system has higher initial setup costs, its operational efficiency and long-term benefits in mitigating environmental risks make it a sustainable choice for public health and environmental management.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Hybrid Model for Movie Recommendation: Integrating CNN and Traditional Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In recent times, a significant portion of entertainment consumption comes from watching movies, prompting movie creation and researchers to seek expert systems that can accurately predict a movie's success probability before production. These days people are used to these things that they want all the recommendations, even though it is not that difficult to choose movies based on own preferences. Many users often rely on search engines for specific movie-related information, highlighting the importance of recommendation systems that analyze past search behaviors and interests. This study develops a movie recommendation system using publicly available Internet Movie Database (IMDB) data, employing a hybrid model approach that integrates Collaborative Filtering (KNN), Latent Factor Modeling (SVD), Content-Based Filtering (TF-IDF), and Sentiment Analysis (CNN). It further presents an analysis of Collaborative and Content-Based recommender systems to assist in selecting suitable machine learning algorithms based on specific requirements. The model achieves an impressive accuracy of 0.9239 with the CNN model, surpassing all benchmark models. These findings underscore the significant potential of predictive and prescriptive data analytics in information systems, providing valuable insights to support industry decision-making in the movie recommendation domain. Additionally, the system effectively handles edge cases, such as non-existent user IDs or movie titles, and ensures that recommendations exclude already rated movies to maintain relevance.

articleTitle: Sampling-Based Density Peaks Clustering for Energy-Aware Industrial IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) settings, effective data processing and energy management are essential due to the resource-limited characteristics of the linked equipment. This research introduces a unique Sampling-Based Density Peaks Clustering (SDPC) algorithm designed for energy-efficient clustering in IIoT networks. The suggested method improves classic Density Peak Clustering by incorporating a sampling mechanism that decreases computational burden while preserving excellent clustering precision. SDPC efficiently clusters devices by determining cluster centers through local density and distance parameters, hence reducing communication costs and prolonging the network’s operational lifespan. The energy consumption model is integrated into the clustering process, prioritizing devices with greater energy reserves as cluster heads, hence enhancing energy load distribution throughout the network. Simulation results indicate that SDPC realizes substantial enhancements, featuring a 30% decrease in energy usage and a 25% augmentation in network durability relative to leading clustering methods. This method has significant potential for enhancing energy management in IIoT networks, facilitating more sustainable and scalable industrial processes.

articleTitle: Advancements in Isogeny-Based Cryptography: A Mathematical Approach to Post-Quantum Security
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we have discussed isogeny-based cryptography as a rather appealing option for post-quantum security. We provide analysis of current protocols like SIDH (Supersingular Isogeny Diffie-Hellman) and SIKE (Supersingular Isogeny Key Encapsulation) setting up fundamental issues with their security and performance. In this work we introduce a novel isogeny pathfinding algorithm that employs graph theory as well as probabilistic models in order to lower its computational complexity. The results show significant improvement in both efficiency and security, strengthening the case for the use of isogeny based systems in a quantum-resilient cryptographic space.

articleTitle: NL2Code: A Hybrid NLP and Model-Driven Framework for Automated Code Generation from Natural Language and UML
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The process of converting natural language requirements and visual models into executable software code remains an ongoing challenge in software engineering. We developed an intelligent system that adopts Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Model-Driven Engineering (MDE) to generate code from natural language requirements and UML diagrams. It then applies advanced NLP techniques for natural language specification, such as tokenization, POS tagging, semantic analysis, and information extraction. This information can be transformed into computer language construct and design patterns with the help of MDE concepts. It generates code templates, skeleton code, and real code and incorporates key principles of software engineering and technological specializations. Case studies explain how the system can improve the software development lifecycle for a development company by automatically translating the natural language and the visual models into code. The system synthesized code with 92-95 % accuracy and 92-93 % completeness in three particular cases of use, proving the efficiency of the translation process of natural language requirements and UML diagrams into executable code. The present work enriches software engineering, NLP, as well as the integration of MDE, and code generation, reducing time consumption, manual efforts, and fast communication in the Software Development Process.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Aadhaar-Based E-Voting System with Facial Recognition for Enhanced Security and Accessibility
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The necessity of digital technology in virtually every field has provided ample opportunity for the modernization and advancement of the electoral, and elections in particular, processes. In this paper the conception and implementation of a web based online election system will be presented with its focal point being the modernization of the voting process while transparency, security and accessibility aspects being central to it. The use of HTML5, CSS3 and responsive designing with the assistance of bootstrap, dynamic content creation through use of JavaScript, or its jQuery library, a robust back-end in the form of PHP and MySQL database and Integration of Aadhaar linked facial recognition to the conduction of elections to aim at maintaining Voter On the systems designed, the simple measures of login with e-mail and passwords, as used in most systems today, is also availed for voters to login into their accounts safely and securely. Voter registration and notices of voting days as well as candidates’ information are all incorporated in the managing admin panel of the election process. All this information concerning the voters and the respective votes is encrypted in order to foster confidentiality and trust. The given online election system fights with those major problems that exist in India, concerning the electorate such as fraud, accessibility and inordinate management of huge manual elections. By using an encrypted digital platform; the election processes for both the voters and the voters’ managers are made to be secure, scalable and transparent. It reflects back to the system’s architecture, the technologies to be deployed and the need for such approaches in the country vis-a-vis aiming for high voter turnout and security of the process.

articleTitle: Automated Coconut Cutting Machine
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Using electrical and sensor-driven components, the automated coconut cutting machine transforms conventional labour-intensive and inconsistent coconut splitting. Starting and stopping sensors, electric motor, gearbox, crankshaft, and water collection unit, define key elements. Machines increase production, reduce labour, and lower expenses. After placing a coconut in the inlet, a sensor activates the motor, cutting precisely and collecting water to reduce waste. The cut halves are directed to an exit. By eliminating manual labour and assuring quality, the machine improves service efficiency in temples, coconut processing industries, and food units. By combining mechanical design with electrical sensor technology for best, dependable solutions, this automated method fosters a cleaner, safer workplace and fits with modern agricultural and food industry trends. Review and analysis show the machine's force to shatter the coconut, water collection efficiency, and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Next-Generation Embedded Systems with Synergies VLSI with Deep Learning: Design Methodologies, Optimization Techniques, and Real-World Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: New generation of embedded systems with superior intelligence, energy efficiency, and performance have emerged as a result of the merging of deep learning with Very-Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) technology. Methodologies for design, optimisation strategies, and practical uses of next-generation embedded systems are the foci of this study, which investigates the ways in which VLSI and deep learning might work together. These systems have the potential to transform several industries, such as transportation, medicine, robotics, and the IoT, by harnessing the processing power of deep neural networks with the improvements in semiconductor fabrication. Prior to delving into the advantages of bespoke hardware design for deep learning inference and training, we trace the history of very large scale integration (VLSI) technology and its incorporation with deep learning algorithms. Investigated here are the design techniques that, when applied to very large scale integration (VLSI) architectures like FPGAs and ASICs, allow for the efficient mapping of deep learning models onto these devices. We show case studies that show how these methods work and talk about the trade-offs between performance, power consumption, and adaptability. The development of next-generation embedded systems relies heavily on optimisation approaches. Model compression, quantisation, and pruning are some of the optimisation strategies that we examine; they lessen the memory and computational demands of deep learning models without drastically altering their accuracy. For embedded devices with limited resources, these methods are crucial for implementing deep learning models. Additionally, we explore the practical uses of embedded systems augmented with VLSI and deep learning. By capitalising on the complementary strengths of VLSI and deep learning, applications like autonomous driving, medical imaging, and smart home automation are revolutionising entire industries. In this paper, we examine the design, optimisation, and deployment of such systems in depth, as well as the potential and threats they pose. We conclude by discussing potential future developments and areas for future research in the subject, such as improved very large scale integration (VLSI) designs, novel deep learning models, and the incorporation of cutting-edge technologies like quantum computing and neuromorphic computing. The study highlights how next-gen embedded systems can tackle complicated problems in a dynamic technology environment and foster innovation.

articleTitle: Decentralized and Distributed Control Strategies for Microgrids: A Review of Key Techniques and Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Microgrids have emerged as a key solution for enhancing the flexibility, reliability, and sustainability of power systems. As the penetration of renewable energy sources and distributed generation increases, effective control strategies are essential for ensuring stable and efficient microgrid operation. This paper presents a comprehensive review of decentralized and distributed control strategies for microgrids, highlighting their significance in enabling scalability, robustness, and resilience. Key techniques, such as primary, secondary, and tertiary control layers, are discussed, with a focus on the transition from centralized to decentralized paradigms. The review explores the application of advanced algorithms like multi-agent systems (MAS), consensus-based control, and artificial intelligence (AI) for optimizing power sharing, voltage regulation, frequency stability, and energy management in islanded and grid-connected modes. Additionally, the paper analyzes the challenges and opportunities in implementing decentralized and distributed control, with real-world case studies and simulation-based insights to demonstrate their effectiveness in various microgrid configurations. Finally, potential future research directions are suggested to address emerging trends such as peer-to-peer energy trading, blockchain-based energy systems, and the integration of electric vehicles (EVs) into microgrid networks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cardiovascular Risk Prediction through Age-Based and Behavioral Health Indicator Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are among the leading causes of death globally, causing around 17.9 million deaths every year, as reported by the WHO. Patient outcomes would also be maximally improved if predictions and management were to be made available early, especially in regions that are resource-scarce. The prevailing conventional diagnosis has mainly relied on relatively costly tests, such as angiography and electrocardiograms (ECG). However, the developing field of machine learning now provides a cost-effective and efficient way of analyzing health data to predict the risk of heart disease. This paper introduces a new approach that integrates, in the heart disease predictive models, factors concerning psychological states, such as stress, hours worked, and sleep patterns. Using the Cleveland Heart Disease dataset enriched with synthetic features representing mental health, we track the amount each of these factors contributes to predictions. We also show personalized modeling based directly on training within demographic subgroups- age under 40 versus 40 years of age or older, as well as gender - for determining whether such personal models are better than global models. We use many ML classifiers, namely Random Forest, XGBoost, KNN, SVM, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Naive Bayes, to develop and compare the prediction models. All the models are assessed both on the original dataset as well as the augmented dataset using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score. Incorporating mental health indicators significantly improves the power of the models and lends importance to the balanced monitoring of health in cardiovascular care. When specific groups of patients are considered for the demographic-based models, the performance is good, and it underlines possible applications in personalized healthcare solutions.

articleTitle: Object Detection for Assisting Blind Individuals Using ESP32-CAM and GPS
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to develop a conceptual framework of assistive technologies that will help meet the objective of increasing the independence and safety of visually impaired persons. This framework is based on recent innovations in object detection, depth sensing, and communication for real-time spatial awareness and response. To increase efficiency in gathering the environment data the system combines several hardware components such as a high frame rate web camera, infrared depth sensor as well as ESP32-CAM microcontroller board that plays a crucial role in capturing visions and spatial data. The object detection feature, which forms the basis of the system, uses the YOLO algorithm a prominent algorithm in real-time object recognition and localization that allows the framework to quickly identify and locate objects in the user’s environment. From the software side, the sensor inclusion and data treatment are maintained with ordinary C++ of the Arduino-Based hardware. The companion application is built with React Native and is best suited to Android platforms with additional nice features of its user-friendly interface. These are major features of this application which include notification or warning to the user of the obstacles, landmarks, or areas of interest around the environment. Also, the system under development has incorporated real-time GPS tracking so that the attendant or family members can have an idea of where the user is at any given time, giving more security. Featuring an innovative compact and wheelable design, this mobility solution aims to decrease the level of reliance of the visually impaired individual on mechanized aids or human guidance assistance with activities such as walking and getting around during daily activities in unknown territories. Thus, this work brings the advanced sensory and notification technologies in one small pocket device which is an actual and practical invention solely serving to enhance the lives of visually impaired citizens. Not only does this innovative approach thus improve individual liberty but it also demonstrates how assistive technologies can deliver better options for mobility for people with vision impairments, from a safety perspective.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review of Strategies For Optimal Efficiency In Integrated Renewable Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Energy provision is becoming a challenging issue for nations to handle to maintain the smooth operation of their economies. To cater to rising demand, attention has turned towards implementing renewable energy systems that are a reality, sustainable and capable of providing active power supply throughout. This is even more important in rural areas, where access to reliable energy can be the biggest booster for development and economic growth. The pressures of global modernization on energy resources suggest a need to examine strategies for increased performance levels from integrated renewable energy systems. Various integration approaches are discussed in this review, addressing where the multiple opportunities can be best applied to meet the energy needs of rural settings. This paper presents different RE combinations to identify the influences and determinants of their performance and considers how effective and feasible they are for a specific context.

articleTitle: Hardware Accelerators for Deep Learning Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are essential for AI applications like computer vision, medical diagnosis, and autonomous vehicles, due to their exceptional performance. However, as DNN models grow increasingly complex, they demand substantial computational power that general-purpose processors struggle to provide. To meet these needs, domain-specific hardware accelerators, including GPU-based, TPU-based, in-memory, FPGA, and ASIC-based accelerators, have been developed. GPU-based accelerators, such as those from NVIDIA, excel in parallel processing, making them ideal for large-scale computations. TPU-based accelerators, optimized by Google for machine learning, offer impressive speed and efficiency. In-memory accelerators overcome memory bottlenecks by storing data close to computation units, enhancing data access speed. FPGA-based accelerators can be highly customized for specific tasks, while ASIC-based accelerators, tailored for specific applications, deliver the highest performance and energy efficiency, albeit at a higher development cost. This paper reviews the necessity of these accelerators, their types, and their potential impact on the future of AI technology.

articleTitle: A Scalable and Secure Facial Recognition Attendance System Leveraging CNN Algorithms for Real-Time Accuracy and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The facial recognition attendance system represents a modern approach to attendance tracking, designed to improve efficiency, accuracy, and security in various organizational settings. Advanced biometric technologies are leveraged to capture and encode facial features, creating unique digital identifiers for each individual. The methodology employs cutting-edge facial recognition algorithms powered by convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with a 99.5% recognition accuracy rate. These algorithms extract and encode facial vectors with sub-millisecond latency, which are then compared in real-time against a secure, encrypted database of preregistered individuals. Upon a successful match, the system automatically records the attendance, ensuring an accurate and efficient process. With an intuitive web interface built on ReactJS and a backend supported by Node.js and MongoDB, the system provides seamless access to attendance records and administrative functionalities. The entire attendance recording process is optimized for speed, typically completing within two seconds per individual. Additionally, advanced anti-spoofing measures and integration support with existing HR management systems redefine traditional attendance management practices with a scalable, robust, and secure solution. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Face Recognition CCTV for Automated Attendance Tracking
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study investigates the design and execution of an automated attendance tracking system using facial recognition CCTV based . Facial recognition technology and CCTV cameras are integrated in this system to provide a seamless, frictionless way to track and record attendance in real time. In addition to boosting attendance record accuracy, the approach reduces the administrative burden associated with using traditional methods. The suggested system is designed to recognise people when they enter or leave a monitored area by leveraging developments in computer vision. It accomplishes this automatically and requires no interaction from humans. Furthermore, the system's use of the Internet of Things makes it flexible and scalable to a variety of business situations, including offices, schools, and large-scale events. This is made feasible via real-time data synchronising and reporting.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and Fuzzy Integration for Lung Disease Detection using VGG16
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Lung conditions, including pneumonia, TB, and lung cancer, represent a considerable worldwide health challenge. Timely identification is essential for enhancing patient outcomes; nevertheless, conventional diagnostic techniques frequently exhibit deficiencies in precision and rapidity. This study introduces a sophisticated system that integrates deep learning methodologies with fuzzy logic to improve lung disease identification. We utilize the VGG16 architecture for feature extraction from medical pictures, specifically X-rays and CT scans, capitalizing on its robust pre-trained layers to discern complex patterns suggestive of pulmonary problems. We utilize fuzzy logic in decision-making to enhance detection, hence addressing uncertainty in medical imaging data. Experimental findings indicate that the integrated model attains an accuracy of 90% and an F1-score of 0.88, markedly surpassing conventional CNN methodologies. The model’s robustness and generalization are additionally confirmed via cross-validation by attaining an average accuracy of 91%.

articleTitle: InsightNav - Empowering Desktop Navigation with Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: InsightNav redefines desktop interaction by harnessing cutting-edge computer vision and AI technologies to deliver a transformative user experience. Beyond its intuitive gesture-based navigation, InsightNav pioneers two groundbreaking features that elevate human-computer interaction. The first, Personalized Desktop Themes Based on Emotion Detection, leverages real-time facial expression analysis to dynamically alter the desktop’s visual aesthetics based on the user's mood. This innovation empowers the system to foster emotional well-being, transitioning to serene themes during stress or energizing designs to amplify motivation. The second feature, Voice-Activated Multitasking Snap Layouts, revolutionizes task management by enabling users to orchestrate optimized application layouts through simple voice commands. By uttering phrases like "Focus Mode," users can seamlessly arrange tools such as browsers, editors, and readers, thereby accelerating productivity and streamlining workflows. Powered by MediaPipe, OpenCV, and Google Speech-to-Text, InsightNav transcends traditional interaction paradigms, offering unparalleled accessibility, efficiency, and personalization. Together, these innovations position InsightNav as a revolutionary tool, setting new benchmarks in adaptive and immersive human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Polynomial and exponential synchronization of coupled neural networks with Proportional delay via event triggered saturated impulsive control under DoS attacks and its Application to image encryption
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenges of achieving polynomial and exponential synchronization in coupled neural networks with proportional delay under Denial of Service (DoS) attacks. We propose a novel control technique, incorporating an event-triggered saturated impulsive control, designed to minimize communication transmission signals. This approach not only effectively mitigates the impact of DoS attacks but also reduces network load while preserving acceptable system performance. Using the matrix measure method and Halanay-type inequalities, we derive sufficient conditions for ensuring polynomial and exponential synchronization in the system. Additionally, numerical simulations are provided to validate the theoretical results in the presence of DoS attacks. For the image encryption algorithm, we utilize a chaotic sequence combined with a scrambling technique based on an enhanced Arnold’s cat map, yielding strong encryption properties that defend against statistical attacks.

articleTitle: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Regional Dialect Comprehended Question answering in Bangla
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: For diverse languages like Bangla, maintaining regional dialects can be a major challenge. The dialect from one region can be difficult to understand for people with dialects of another region and thus, automated system to answer the questions of a particular dialect can be helpful. In this paper, we present a new dataset comprising 12,500 sentences from various regional dialects including Chittagong, Noakhali, Sylhet, Barishal, and Mymensingh, alongside their replies in the same dialect. Afterward, we developed dialect-sensitive chatbots through fine-tuning via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Our comprehensive evaluation of four leading language models - ChatGPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Mistral-7B, and Gemma-2-9B - reveals significant variations in their ability to process regional Bangla dialects. ChatGPT-4o emerged as the top performer with BLEU scores of 53%, followed by Claude 3.5 Sonnet demonstrating a score of 46%, Gemma-2-9B achieving 42%, and Mistral-7B achieving 40%.

articleTitle: Human Evolutionary Optimization Algorithm for Optimal IoT Task Placement in Hybrid Cloud-Fog Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The growing prevalence of Internet of Things (IoT) devices necessitates the strategic allocation of computational activities inside cloud-fog networks to achieve low latency, diminished energy consumption, and optimal resource utilisation. This study introduces a new Human Evolutionary Optimisation Algorithm (HEOA) designed for optimising IoT job placement inside hybrid cloud-fog environments. The suggested method emulates human decision-making to provide adaptive and intelligent job allocation, optimising computational load distribution between centralised cloud data centres and decentralised fog nodes. HEOA employs evolutionary processes, including selection, mutation, and crossover, to dynamically identify the ideal configuration for job offloading, therefore reducing response time and energy expenditures. Simulation studies indicate that HEOA surpasses conventional optimisation methods by attaining quicker convergence, enhanced resource efficiency, and superior scalability. The HEOA diminished energy usage by 12% and cut response time by 15%, rendering it highly compatible with contemporary IoT applications. This study enhances job scheduling frameworks in diverse cloud-fog settings, facilitating improved performance and sustainability in IoT ecosystems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and EEG Signal Based Biometric System: An Application of Brain Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: User identification is explored through EEG-based biometric analysis using different auditory stimuli, using the distinctiveness and security of EEG signals for reliable biometric authentication. The impact on system performance due to different auditory stimuli, namely native language songs, non-native language songs, and neutral music, was evaluated using a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) model for classification. The 1D-CNN model demonstrated strong performance with an average sensitivity of 0.9666±0.10, showing its ability to correctly identify individuals using auditory stimuli. Average specificity was 0.9982±0.01, indicating excellent user differentiation and low misidentifications. The average Equal Error Rate (EER) was 0.0318±0.29, confirming the system’s reliability in recognizing users based on pattern of EEG signals.

articleTitle: Classification of Dna-Protein Interactions Based on Protein Structure and Sequence Using Convolution Neural Networks and Encoding Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Over recent years, various machine learning techniques have effectively accomplished this goal. The feature selection and extraction process pose the greatest challenge in traditional DNA sequence classification techniques. Representing data becomes even more complex with abundant information, especially when dealing with sequences like DNA that lack clear built-in features. It remains factual that the feature extraction phase in supervised classification problems using machine learning algorithms is pivotal. Meaningful characteristics of the objects to be classified must be identified and evaluated to construct an appropriate representation. New models, known as deep learning, can autonomously extract meaningful features from input data. In this investigation, we delve into applying Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for genome analysis, binding structure analysis, and classification tasks. The study commences with the collection of DNA sequences and their corresponding labels, ensuring data integrity through pre-processing. Subsequently, two distinct encoding techniques—label encoding and one-hot encoding—are utilized as input for the proposed CNN classification model, which integrates an embedded layer to represent DNA sequences. CNN models employing label encoding outperformed other encoding strategies, achieving a classification accuracy of 97.22%.

articleTitle: Wireless Charging Technologies for Electric Vehicles: State of the Art and Future Outlook
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Wireless charging technology for electric vehicles (EVs) represents a significant advancement in the transition to sustainable transportation, offering a convenient and efficient alternative to traditional plug-in charging systems. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the state-of-the-art wireless charging techniques, with a focus on inductive power transfer (IPT), resonant inductive coupling, and emerging capacitive and magnetic resonance methods. Key components of wireless charging systems, including power electronics, coil design, alignment techniques, and communication protocols, are discussed. We also address the challenges related to efficiency, safety, standardization, and scalability, particularly in dynamic charging systems designed for highway applications. The paper further explores the integration of wireless charging into smart grids, considering the potential for vehicle-to-grid (V2G) applications and renewable energy sources. A comparative analysis of existing technologies and their readiness for widespread adoption is provided, alongside an outlook on future trends, including high-power charging, autonomous charging infrastructure, and advances in materials and control algorithms. The paper concludes by identifying research gaps and potential directions for innovation in wireless charging for EVs.

articleTitle: Advanced Fire Detection and Extinguishing Rover with YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The project 'Advanced Fire Detection and Extinguishing Rover utilizing YOLOv8' introduces a cutting-edge, fire-detection and suppression system that uses deep learning and robotic automation to improve safety. The system uses the YOLOv8 object identification model, which was trained on several fire-related datasets, to effectively identify fire dangers in real-time using live video feeds processed using Python and OpenCV. When the system detects a fire with a high confidence score, it labels the impacted regions and sends the rover driven by the remote controlled and Arduino microcontroller. The rover's servo motor independently directs an inbuilt fire extinguisher to extinguish flames. Bluetooth allows remote monitoring and control, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and securely. This combination of artificial intelligence, computer vision, and robotics provides a revolutionary method for proactive fire-risk mitigation that aims to reduce damage, improve safety, and save lives.

articleTitle: Implementing and Managing Green IT Strategies to Enhance Corporate Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Importance of Green IT practices is that it improves corporate sustainability through conserving the natural environment and minimizing the use of resource. This paper focuses on next generation IT management for power-optimized hardware, virtualization, cloud computing, and intelligent system through SITOF. Some of the key technologies are: ARM-based low power servers, vSphere-server visualization, Docker- Containerization, Solar/wind hybrid power. It shows that the main benefits of the IT of smart buildings are a 35% saving in energy and 40% reduction in carbons, as well as a quarter decrease in operation costs when compared to traditional IT practices. Moreover, data analytic improve performance measurement and management and hence contributing to an improvement in sustainability issues. These results also show that SITOF is feasible to assist firms in attaining corporate sustainability objectives while embracing the best practice of technology management.

articleTitle: Multi-Granularity Evolutionary Clustering Algorithm for Energy Efficiency in Industrial IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The evolutionary method facilitates adaptive clustering by investigating an extensive search space of possible configurations, guaranteeing optimal cluster formation for diverse Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) scenarios. Comprehensive simulations illustrate the efficacy of the proposed MGECA framework in attaining substantial energy savings relative to conventional clustering techniques, including LEACH and KMeans. The findings demonstrate that the MGECA framework prolongs network longevity by an average of 28.5 hours, signifying a 27.8% enhancement compared to LEACH and an 18.2% enhancement relative to K-Means. The proposed method attained a data transmission efficiency of 95% at 50 hours, exceeding LEACH’s 85% and K-Means’ 75% efficiency rates. The frequency of cluster reconfiguration was optimised to 3.5 hours, representing a 32.7% reduction compared to LEACH. The results underscore the MGECA framework’s potential as a robust and scalable solution for energy-efficient clustering in extensive IIoT networks, thereby enhancing the sustainability and reliability of industrial systems while improving performance metrics essential for effective IIoT implementations.

articleTitle: Rack Sensor Metrics Odyssey: Analyzing Sensor Behavior with Random Forest and kNN for Strategic Job Allocation Insights
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Data centers are vital to modern computing but contribute significantly to carbon emissions due to their high energy consumption. To address this, machine learning models can optimize resource allocation by analyzing sensor metrics. In this study, the Random Forest Regressor was chosen for its ability to capture sensor behavior, even showing negative R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> values, aligning with observed patterns. Meanwhile, k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) emerged as the best model for learning from the same data, despite irregularities, with R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> values ranging between 0.6 and 1. This analysis supports sustainable data center management by enhancing energy efficiency and minimizing environmental impact. Future work will explore the integration of these models into simulation environments.

articleTitle: Smart Cap Design For Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The technologies constantly try to make human lifestyles easier. The folks who are visually Impaired they faces many problems throughout navigation This paper presents the layout and implementation of a clever Cap utilising text-to-speech (TTS) to help visually impaired individuals in ordinary activities. The smart Cap is equipped with a camera that captures printed text from books, labels, or symptoms and converts it into audible speech. thru actual-time audio feedback, customers can receive information approximately their environment, read documents, or understand product details. The tool additionally carries voice command functionality, taking into consideration smooth control and interaction.

articleTitle: Impact of Electric Vehicle Integration on Power Grids: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The rapid growth of electric vehicles (EVs) poses significant challenges and opportunities for modern power grids. This comprehensive review examines the impact of large-scale EV integration on power grid infrastructure, focusing on key areas such as load demand, grid stability, energy storage, and renewable energy integration. We analyze the effects of EV charging on peak loads, voltage regulation, and grid reliability, highlighting the need for advanced control strategies and smart grid technologies. Additionally, this paper explores bidirectional power flow, vehicle-to-grid (V2G) systems, and their potential to enhance grid resilience and support renewable energy adoption. Through a detailed examination of current research and emerging trends, we present potential solutions for mitigating integration challenges, including smart charging, demand response, and distributed energy resources. This review provides insights into how the synergy between EVs and power grids can lead to more sustainable and efficient energy systems.

articleTitle: DocQueue: A Scheduling Algorithm for Optimizing Healthcare Resources
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: DocQueue is a cloud-based system that optimizes patient scheduling in order to maximize the delivery of healthcare by prioritizing cases (dynamically) based on real-time information and availability of resources. It uses a decision-tree algorithm to analyze symptoms in real time, and then flags high-priority cases immediately, but uses a round-robin scheduling mechanism to manage low-priority cases so things are fair. And the AWS based architecture of the system allows for scalable deployment throughout the healthcare continuum. In simulations, these changes have shown to drastically cut down patient waiting time and make better use of resources, and therefore provide better patient care and more efficient operations. DocQueue is different from the usual scheduling systems because it is flexible and data-driven, it can change its schedule based on the real time needs of health care.

articleTitle: Real Time Web Traffic Forecasting Using LSTM and CNN
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A Real-Time Web Traffic Forecasting System Using Hybrid LSTM and CNN Paper Development of the real-time web traffic forecasting system uses a hybrid approach combining LSTM with Conventional Neural Networks (CNN) to forecast website visitor counts and user engagement metrics for better resource and server scalability and in turn user experience. Methodology This entails the utilization of machine learning techniques in a time series forecasting context, as well as data preprocessing to truthfully make short-term forecasts. The results proved that the hybrid model performs better than the traditional statistical models like ARIMA, and this has significant impacts on dynamic management of resources. For optimized management of loads on the server, real-time traffic forecasting of web traffic is necessary. The system exploits both linear and non-linear relationships of data and, hence, makes for better short-term predictions than do conventional ARIMA techniques. This paper describes the design, implementation, and evaluation of the hybrid model with the objective of proving its superiority over the complex patterns of web traffic. The results have been much better in terms of prediction, reduced system downtime, and increased efficiency in operational functioning-land on a road to resource optimization and proactive infrastructure management.

articleTitle: Efficient Feature Extraction Methods for Enhanced Mango and Groundnut Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: India's agricultural sector is vital to the economy, sustaining millions of farmers, but plant diseases threaten crop productivity and livelihoods. Traditional disease diagnosis methods rely on manual observation, are labor-intensive, and prone to misdiagnosis due to subtle or unclear symptoms. To address these challenges, machine learning techniques have emerged as efficient and accurate alternatives. This study investigates optimized feature extraction techniques for classifying diseases in mango and groundnut crops. Using images of healthy and diseased leaves from Maharashtra’s Kolhapur and Ratnagiri districts, we analyze feature extraction methods like SVM, KNN, and RF. Our results show that refining feature extraction improves classification accuracy, achieving a 95% accuracy with RF. These findings highlight the potential of advanced machine learning models to enhance crop health management and support precision agriculture practices.

articleTitle: Implementation of Quadrant based Dual-Beam Laser Interference Lithography Technique
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study investigates the application of dual-beam laser interference lithography technique (DBLIL) using a four-quadrant coordinate system to overcome implementation challenges. DBLIL is renowned for its capability to generate high-resolution periodic patterns, making it an efficient technique for fabricating micro- and nanostructures across various substrates. By splitting and recombining a coherent laser beam at specific angles, DBLIL forms interference patterns that create the desired structures. The research highlights the technique's simplicity, cost-effectiveness, and large-area uniformity, and explores its principles through MATLAB simulations. The findings aim to optimize DBLIL parameters by controlling the phase shift, wavelength and quadrants to enhance its application in fields such as photonics, electronics, and materials science, with a particular focus on application in biomedicine.

articleTitle: A Detailed Exploration to Deepfake: A Cybersecurity Threat
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The advancement of AI-technologies has brought both innovation and considerable challenges particularly with the emergence of deep fakes-realistic but false images, videos or audios created using deep learning algorithms. These deepfakes pose a serious threat as they can spread misleading information or content which are utilized for malicious purposes. This paper focuses on the creation of deepfake and emphasizing on various models like GANs, CNNs, and LSTMs. This paper also provides a comparative analysis of various deepfake detection techniques and prevention measures to take into considerations.

articleTitle: Personalized Mental Health Assistance: Integrating Emotion Prediction with GPT-Based Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Mental health is a fundamental aspect of overall wellbeing, despite its importance, it remains one of the most neglected issues. By integrating Artificial Intelligence with Natural Language Processing into this domain helps to bridge the gaps and challenges. The proposed methodology provides easier access to mental health support by integrating emotion prediction, using the Bi-LSTM Model, with GPT-based chatbots. This system is designed to analyse user inputs, estimating the likelihood of various emotional states such as Anxiety, Depression, Stress, and Suicidal thoughts. These emotional probabilities are then used to inform and guide the responses generated by the GPT model, ensuring that the interactions are more relevant and supportive. Additionally, our approach focuses on providing personalized mental health care using sentiment analysis and prompt engineering. By understanding and interpreting users' emotional states, the chatbot can dynamically adjust its interactions to better meet the needs of everyone, thus improving the quality of mental health support.

articleTitle: XGSybil :A Framework for Modeling and Identifying Sybil Attacks in Intelligent Transportation Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With the increasing adoption of autonomous vehicles, ensuring the security of Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs) is critical to maintaining road safety and efficiency. Among the potential threats, Sybil attacks pose a significant challenge by enabling malicious vehicles to illegitimately assume multiple identities, disrupting communication and causing traffic mismanagement. This paper addresses the simulation and detection of Sybil attacks in Intelligent Transportation systems using a combination of network simulation and machine learning. Realistic traffic environments are replicated using tools such as OpenStreetMap, SUMO, and OMNeT++, and attack scenarios are simulated to generate datasets. A machine learning model, trained on these datasets, detects Sybil attacks by analyzing vehicle acceleration and behavioral patterns. The proposed approach successfully identifies malicious nodes, invalidates fraudulent messages, and mitigates their impact, thereby enhancing the security and reliability of autonomous vehicle networks. This study provides a robust framework for Sybil attack detection and contributes to the broader field of secure intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent hierarchical workflow for autonomous code generation with Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents a multi-agent hierarchical workflow tailored for automating data analysis, code generation, and visualization, focusing specifically on user-provided CSV datasets. The workflow integrates AlphaCodium with LangChain, LangGraph, and GPT, enabling autonomous code generation, unit test development, and debugging. The system operates by analyzing the uploaded dataset, assigning agents that work sequentially: a programmer agent generates code using the Skeleton-Of-Code approach, a unit test agent verifies the code, and an executor agent runs the code. A debugging agent is also included to identify and resolve any issues. The AI agents involved are capable of dynamically accessing online resources, including documentation and references to enhance their decision-making processes. This work attempts to exemplify the application of AI in automating not only code execution but also the planning and validation stages by writing unit tests in the software development process to reflect the increasing role of AI in advancing automation for rapid code generation within the software industry.

articleTitle: Enhancing Emotional Voice Conversion with Intensity Control and Mixed Embedding
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
